wlc: וַאֲחֵיהֶם לְבֵית אֲבוֹתֵיהֶם מִיכָאֵל וּמְשֻׁלָּם וְשֶׁבַע וְיוֹרַי וְיַעְכָּן וְזִיעַ וָעֵבֶר שִׁבְעָה ׃ ס
lxx: καὶ οἱ ἀδελφοὶ αὐτῶν κατʼ οἴκους πατριῶν αὐτῶν· Μιχαήλ, Μοσολὰμ καὶ Σέβεε καὶ Ἰωρεὲ καὶ Χιμὰ καὶ Ζοῦε καὶ Ὠβήδ, ὀκτώ.
vulg: fratres vero eorum secundum domos cognationum suarum Michahel et Mosollam et Sebe et Iori et Iachan et Zie et Heber septem
clem: Fratres vero eorum secundum domos cognationum suarum, Michal, et Mosollam, et Sebe, et Jorai, et Jachan, et Zie, et Heber, septem.
kjv: And their brethren of the house of their fathers were, Michael, and Meshullam, and Sheba, and Jorai, and Jachan, and Zia, and Heber, seven.

wlc: אֵלֶּה בְּנֵי אֲבִיחַיִל בֶּן־חוּרִי בֶּן־יָרוֹחַ בֶּן־גִּלְעָד בֶּן־מִיכָאֵל בֶּן־יְשִׁישַׁי בֶּן־יַחְדּוֹ בֶּן־בּוּז ׃
lxx: οὗτοι υἱοὶ Ἀβειχαιὰ υἱοὶ Oὑρεὶ υἱρῦ Ἰδαὶ υἱοῦ Γαλαὰδ υἱοῦ Μειχαὴλ υἱοῦ Ἰσοὶ υἱοῦ Ἰουρεὶ υἱρῦ Ζαβουχὰμ
vulg: hii filii Abiahil filii Uri filii Iaro filii Galaad filii Michahel filii Iesesi filii Ieddo filii Buz
clem: Hi filii Abihail, filii Huri, filii Jara, filii Galaad, filii Michal, filii Jesesi, filii Jeddo, filii Buz.
kjv: These are the children of Abihail the son of Huri, the son of Jaroah, the son of Gilead, the son of Michael, the son of Jeshishai, the son of Jahdo, the son of Buz;

wlc: אֲחִי בֶּן־עַבְדִּיאֵל בֶּן־גּוּנִי רֹאשׁ לְבֵית אֲבוֹתָם ׃
lxx: υἱοῦ Ἀβδεὴλ υὰὸῦ Γουνεί· ἄρχων οἴκου πατριῶν,
vulg: fratres quoque filii Abdihel filii Guni princeps domus in familiis suis
clem: Fratres quoque, filii Abdiel filii Guni, princeps domus in familiis suis.
kjv: Ahi the son of Abdiel, the son of Guni, chief of the house of their fathers.

wlc: וַיֵּשְׁבוּ בַּגִּלְעָד בַּבָּשָׁן וּבִבְנֹתֶיהָ וּבְכָל־מִגְרְשֵׁי שָׁרוֹן עַל־תוֹצְאוֹתָם ׃
lxx: κατοίκων ἐν Γαλαάμ, ἐν Βασὰμ καὶ ἐν ταῖς κώμαις αὐτῶν καὶ πάντα τὰ περίχαρα Ιεριὰμ ἕως ἐξόδου.
vulg: et habitaverunt in Galaad et in Basan et in viculis eius et in cunctis suburbanis Saron usque ad terminos
clem: Et habitaverunt in Galaad, et in Basan, et in viculis ejus, et in cunctis suburbanis Saron, usque ad terminos.
kjv: And they dwelt in Gilead in Bashan, and in her towns, and in all the suburbs of Sharon, upon their borders.

wlc: כֻּלָּם הִתְיַחְשׂוּ בִּימֵי יוֹתָם מֶלֶךְ־יְהוּדָה וּבִימֵי יָרָבְעָם מֶלֶךְ־יִשְׂרָאֵל ׃ פ
lxx: πάντων ὁ καταλοχισμὸς ἐν ἡμέραις Ἰωαθὰμ βασιλέως Ἰούδα καὶ ἐν ἡμέραις Ἰεροβοὰμ βασιλέως Ἰσραήλ.
vulg: omnes hii numerati sunt in diebus Ioatham regis Iuda et in diebus Hieroboam regis Israhel
clem: Omnes hi numerati sunt in diebus Joathan regis Juda, et in diebus Jeroboam regis Isral.
kjv: All these were reckoned by genealogies in the days of Jotham king of Judah, and in the days of Jeroboam king of Israel.

wlc: בְּנֵי־רְאוּבֵן וְגָדִי וַחֲצִי שֵׁבֶט־מְנַשֶּׁה מִן־בְּנֵי־חַיִל אֲנָשִׁים נֹשְׂאֵי מָגֵן וְחֶרֶב וְדֹרְכֵי קֶשֶׁת וּלְמוּדֵי מִלְחָמָה אַרְבָּעִים וְאַרְבָּעָה אֶלֶף וּשְׁבַע־מֵאוֹת וְשִׁשִּׁים יֹצְאֵי צָבָא ׃
lxx: Υἱοὶ Ῥουβὴν καὶ Γὰδ καὶ ἥμισυ φυλῆς Μανασσὴ ἐξ υἱῶν δυνάμεως, ἄνδρες αἴροντες ἀσπίδας καὶ μάχαιραν καὶ τείνοντες τόξον καὶ δεδιδαγμένοι πόλεμον, τεσσεράκοντα καὶ τέσσαρες χιλιάδες καὶ ἑπτακόσιοι καὶ ἑξήκοντα ἐκπορευόμενοι εἰς παράταξιν.
vulg: filii Ruben et Gad et dimidiae tribus Manasse viri bellatores scuta portantes et gladios et tendentes arcum eruditique ad proelia quadraginta quattuor milia et septingenti sexaginta procedentes ad pugnam
clem: Filii Ruben, et Gad, et dimidi tribus Manasse, viri bellatores, scuta portantes et gladios, et tendentes arcum, eruditique ad prlia, quadraginta quatuor millia et septingenti sexaginta, procedentes ad pugnam.
kjv: The sons of Reuben, and the Gadites, and half the tribe of Manasseh, of valiant men, men able to bear buckler and sword, and to shoot with bow, and skilful in war, were four and forty thousand seven hundred and threescore, that went out to the war.

wlc: וַיַּעֲשׂוּ מִלְחָמָה עִם־הַהַגְרִיאִים וִיטוּר וְנָפִישׁ וְנוֹדָב ׃
lxx: καὶ ἐποίουν πόλεμον μετὰ τῶν Ἀγαρηνῶν καὶ Τουραίων καὶ Ναφεισαδαίων καὶ Ναδαβαίων,
vulg: dimicaverunt contra Agarenos Iturei vero et Naphei et Nodab
clem: Dimicaverunt contra Agareos: Ituri vero, et Naphis, et Nodab
kjv: And they made war with the Hagarites, with Jetur, and Nephish, and Nodab.

wlc: וַיֵּעָזְרוּ עֲלֵיהֶם וַיִּנָּתְנוּ בְיָדָם הַהַגְרִיאִים וְכֹל שֶׁעִמָּהֶם כִּי לֵאלֹהִים זָעֲקוּ בַּמִּלְחָמָה וְנַעְתּוֹר לָהֶם כִּי־בָטְחוּ בוֹ ׃
lxx: καὶ κατίσχυσαν ἐπʼ αὐτῶν· καὶ ἐδόθησαν εἰς χεῖρας αὐτῶν οἱ Ἀγεραῖοι καὶ πάντα τὰ σκηνώματα αὐτῶν· ὅτι πρὸς τὸν θεὸν ἐβόησαν ἐν τῷ πολέμῳ καὶ ἐπήκουσεν αὐτοῖς, ὅτι ἥλπισαν ἐπʼ αὐτόν.
vulg: praebuerunt eis auxilium traditique sunt in manus eorum Agareni et universi qui fuerant cum eis quia Deum invocaverunt cum proeliarentur et exaudivit eos eo quod credidissent in eum
clem: prbuerunt eis auxilium. Traditique sunt in manus eorum Agarei, et universi qui fuerant cum eis, quia Deum invocaverunt cum prliarentur: et exaudivit eos, eo quod credidissent in eum.
kjv: And they were helped against them, and the Hagarites were delivered into their hand, and all that were with them: for they cried to God in the battle, and he was intreated of them; because they put their trust in him.

wlc: וַיִּשְׁבּוּ מִקְנֵיהֶם גְּמַלֵּיהֶם חֲמִשִּׁים אֶלֶף וְצֹאן מָאתַיִם וַחֲמִשִּׁים אֶלֶף וַחֲמוֹרִים אַלְפָּיִם וְנֶפֶשׁ אָדָם מֵאָה אָלֶף ׃
lxx: καὶ ήχμαλώτευσαν τὴν ἀποσκευὴν αὐτῶυ, καμήλους πεντακισχιλίας, καὶ προβάτων διακοσίας πεντήκοντα χιλιάδας, ὄνους δισχιλίους, καὶ ψυχὰς ἀνδρῶν ἑκατὸν χιλιάδας·
vulg: ceperuntque omnia quae possederant camelorum quinquaginta milia et ovium ducenta quinquaginta milia asinos duo milia et animas hominum centum milia
clem: Ceperuntque omnia qu possederant, camelorum quinquaginta millia, et ovium ducenta quinquaginta millia, et asinos duo millia, et animas hominum centum millia.
kjv: And they took away their cattle; of their camels fifty thousand, and of sheep two hundred and fifty thousand, and of asses two thousand, and of men an hundred thousand.

wlc: כִּי־חֲלָלִים רַבִּים נָפָלוּ כִּי מֵהָאֱלֹהִים הַמִּלְחָמָה וַיֵּשְׁבוּ תַחְתֵּיהֶם עַד־הַגֹּלָה ׃ פ
lxx: ὅτι τραυματίαι πολλοὶ ἔπεσον, ὅτι παρὰ τοῦ θεοῦ ὁ πόλεμος. καὶ κατῴκησαν ἀντʼ αὐτῶν ἕως τῆς μετοικεσίας.
vulg: vulnerati autem multi corruerunt fuit enim bellum Domini habitaveruntque pro eis usque ad transmigrationem
clem: Vulnerati autem multi corruerunt: fuit enim bellum Domini. Habitaveruntque pro eis usque ad transmigrationem.
kjv: For there fell down many slain, because the war was of God. And they dwelt in their steads until the captivity.

wlc: וּבְנֵי חֲצִי שֵׁבֶט מְנַשֶּׁה יָשְׁבוּ בָּאָרֶץ מִבָּשָׁן עַד־בַּעַל חֶרְמוֹן וּשְׂנִיר וְהַר־חֶרְמוֹן הֵמָּה רָבוּ ׃
lxx: Καὶ οἱ ἡμίσεις φυλῆς Μανασσὴ κατῴκησαν ἀπὸ Βασὰν ἕως Βαιλεὶμ καὶ Σανεὶρ καὶ ὄρος Ἀερμών· καὶ ἐν τῷ Λμβάνῳ αὐτοὶ ἐπλεονάσθησαν.
vulg: filii quoque dimidiae tribus Manasse possederunt terram a finibus Basan usque Baalhermon et Sanir et montem Hermon ingens quippe numerus erat
clem: Filii quoque dimidi tribus Manasse possederunt terram a finibus Basan usque Baal, Hermon, et Sanir, et montem Hermon: ingens quippe numerus erat.
kjv: And the children of the half tribe of Manasseh dwelt in the land: they increased from Bashan unto Baalhermon and Senir, and unto mount Hermon.

wlc: וְאֵלֶּה רָאשֵׁי בֵית־אֲבוֹתָם וְעֵפֶר וְיִשְׁעִי וֶאֱלִיאֵל וְעַזְרִיאֵל וְיִרְמְיָה וְהוֹדַוְיָה וְיַחְדִּיאֵל אֲנָשִׁים גִּבּוֹרֵי חַיִל אַנְשֵׁי שֵׁמוֹת רָאשִׁים לְבֵית אֲבוֹתָם ׃
lxx: καὶ οὗτοι ἀρχηγοὶ οἴκου πατριῶν αὐτῶν· Ὄφερ καὶ Σεεὶ καὶ Ἐλειὴλ καὶ Ἐσδριὴλ καὶ Ἰερμειὰ καὶ Ὡδουιὰ καὶ Ἰελειήλ, ἄνδρες ἰσχυροὶ δυνάμει, ἄνδρες ὀνομαστοί, ἄρχοντες τῶν οἴκων πατριῶν αὐτῶν.
vulg: et hii fuerunt principes domus cognationis eorum Epher et Iesi et Helihel Ezrihel et Hieremia et Odoia et Iedihel viri fortissimi et potentes et nominati duces in familiis suis
clem: Et hi fuerunt principes domus cognationis eorum: Epher, et Jesi, et Eliel, et Ezriel, et Jeremia, et Odoia, et Jediel, viri fortissimi et potentes, et nominati duces in familiis suis.
kjv: And these were the heads of the house of their fathers, even Epher, and Ishi, and Eliel, and Azriel, and Jeremiah, and Hodaviah, and Jahdiel, mighty men of valour, famous men, and heads of the house of their fathers.

wlc: וַיִּמְעֲלוּ בֵּאלֹהֵי אֲבוֹתֵיהֶם וַיִּזְנוּ אַחֲרֵי אֱלֹהֵי עַמֵּי־הָאָרֶץ אֲשֶׁר־הִשְׁמִיד אֱלֹהִים מִפְּנֵיהֶם ׃
lxx: Καὶ ἠθέτησαν ἐν θεῷ πατέρων αὐτῶν, καὶ ἐπόρνευσαν ὀπίσω θεῶν λαῶν τῆς γῆς οὓς ἐξῆρεν ὁ θεὸς ἀπὸ προσώπου αὐτῶν.
vulg: reliquerunt autem Deum patrum suorum et fornicati sunt post deos populorum terrae quos abstulit Dominus coram eis
clem: Reliquerunt autem Deum patrum suorum, et fornicati sunt post deos populorum terr, quos abstulit Deus coram eis.
kjv: And they transgressed against the God of their fathers, and went a whoring after the gods of the people of the land, whom God destroyed before them.

wlc: וַיָּעַר אֱלֹהֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל אֶת־רוּחַ פּוּל מֶלֶךְ־אַשּׁוּר וְאֶת־רוּחַ תִּלְּגַת פִּלְנֶסֶר מֶלֶךְ אַשּׁוּר וַיַּגְלֵם לָראוּבֵנִי וְלַגָּדִי וְלַחֲצִי שֵׁבֶט מְנַשֶּׁה וַיְבִיאֵם לַחְלַח וְחָבוֹר וְהָרָא וּנְהַר גּוֹזָן עַד הַיּוֹם הַזֶּה ׃ פ
lxx: καὶ ἐπήγειρεν ὁ θεὸς Ἰσραὴλ τὸ πνεῦμα Φαλὼχ βασιλέως Ἀσσοὺρ καὶ τὸ πνεῦμα Θαγναφαμάσαρ βασιλέως Ἀσσούρ, καὶ μετῴκισεν τὸν Ῥουβὴν καὶ τὸν Γαδδεὶ καὶ τὸ ἥμισυ φυλῆς Μανασσή, καὶ ἤγαγεν αὐτοὺς εἰς Χαὰχ καὶ Χαβὼρ καὶ ἐπὶ ποταμὸν Χωζὰρ ἕως τῆς ἡμέρας ταύτης.
vulg: et suscitavit Deus Israhel spiritum Ful regis Assyriorum et spiritum Theglathphalnasar regis Assur et transtulit Ruben et Gad et dimidium tribus Manasse et adduxit eos in Alae et Abor et Ara et fluvium Gozan usque ad diem hanc
clem: Et suscitavit Deus Isral spiritum Phul regis Assyriorum, et spiritum Thelgathphalnasar regis Assur: et transtulit Ruben, et Gad, et dimidiam tribum Manasse, et adduxit eos in Lahela, et in Habor, et Ara, et fluvium Gozan, usque ad diem hanc.
kjv: And the God of Israel stirred up the spirit of Pul king of Assyria, and the spirit of Tilgathpilneser king of Assyria, and he carried them away, even the Reubenites, and the Gadites, and the half tribe of Manasseh, and brought them unto Halah, and Habor, and Hara, and to the river Gozan, unto this day.

wlc: בְּנֵי לֵוִי גֵּרְשׁוֹן קְהָת וּמְרָרִי ׃
וּבְנֵי קְהָת עַמְרָם יִצְהָר וְחֶבְרוֹן וְעֻזִּיאֵל ׃ ס
וּבְנֵי עַמְרָם אַהֲרֹן וּמֹשֶׁה וּמִרְיָם ס וּבְנֵי אַהֲרֹן נָדָב וַאֲבִיהוּא אֶלְעָזָר וְאִיתָמָר ׃ ס
אֶלְעָזָר הוֹלִיד אֶת־פִּינְחָס פִּינְחָס הֹלִיד אֶת־אֲבִישׁוּעַ ׃
וַאֲבִישׁוּעַ הוֹלִיד אֶת־בֻּקִּי וּבֻקִּי הוֹלִיד אֶת־עֻזִּי ׃
וְעֻזִּי הוֹלִיד אֶת־זְרַחְיָה וּזְרַחְיָה הוֹלִיד אֶת־מְרָיוֹת ׃
מְרָיוֹת הוֹלִיד אֶת־אֲמַרְיָה וַאֲמַרְיָה הוֹלִיד אֶת־אֲחִיטוּב ׃
וַאֲחִיטוּב הוֹלִיד אֶת־צָדוֹק וְצָדוֹק הוֹלִיד אֶת־אֲחִימָעַץ ׃
וַאֲחִימַעַץ הוֹלִיד אֶת־עֲזַרְיָה וַעֲזַרְיָה הוֹלִיד אֶת־יוֹחָנָן ׃
וְיוֹחָנָן הוֹלִיד אֶת־עֲזַרְיָה הוּא אֲשֶׁר כִּהֵן בַּבַּיִת אֲשֶׁר־בָּנָה שְׁלֹמֹה בִּירוּשָׁלָםִ ׃
וַיּוֹלֶד עֲזַרְיָה אֶת־אֲמַרְיָה וַאֲמַרְיָה הוֹלִיד אֶת־אֲחִיטוּב ׃
וַאֲחִיטוּב הוֹלִיד אֶת־צָדוֹק וְצָדוֹק הוֹלִיד אֶת־שַׁלּוּם ׃
וְשַׁלּוּם הוֹלִיד אֶת־חִלְקִיָּה וְחִלְקִיָּה הוֹלִיד אֶת־עֲזַרְיָה ׃
וַעֲזַרְיָה הוֹלִיד אֶת־שְׂרָיָה וּשְׂרָיָה הוֹלִיד אֶת־יְהוֹצָדָק ׃
וִיהוֹצָדָק הָלַךְ בְּהַגְלוֹת יְהוָה אֶת־יְהוּדָה וִירוּשָׁלִָם בְּיַד נְבֻכַדְנֶאצַּר ׃ ס
בְּנֵי לֵוִי גֵּרְשֹׁם קְהָת וּמְרָרִי ׃
lxx: Υἱοὶ Λευεἰ Γεδσών, Καὰθ καὶ Μαραρεί.
vulg: filii Levi Gersom Caath Merari
clem: Filii Levi: Gerson, Caath, et Merari.
kjv: The sons of Levi; Gershon, Kohath, and Merari.

wlc: וְאֵלֶּה שְׁמוֹת בְּנֵי־גֵרְשׁוֹם לִבְנִי וְשִׁמְעִי ׃
lxx: καὶ υἱοὶ Καάθ· Ἀμβρὰμ καὶ Ἰσσάαρ, Χεβρὼν καὶ Ὀζειήλ.
vulg: filii Caath Amram Isaar Hebron et Ozihel
clem: Filii Caath: Amram, Isaar, Hebron, et Oziel.
kjv: And the sons of Kohath; Amram, Izhar, and Hebron, and Uzziel.

wlc: וּבְנֵי קְהָת עַמְרָם וְיִצְהָר וְחֶבְרוֹן וְעֻזִּיאֵל ׃
lxx: καὶ υἱοὶ Ἀμβράν· Ἀαρὼν καὶ Μωυσῆς καὶ Μαριάμ. καὶ υἱοὶ Ἀαρών· Ναδὰβ καὶ Ἀβούδ, Ἐλεάζαρ καὶ Ἰθαμάρ.
vulg: filii Amram Aaron Moses et Maria filii Aaron Nadab et Abiu Eleazar et Ithamar
clem: Filii Amram: Aaron, Moyses, et Maria. Filii Aaron: Nadab et Abiu, Eleazar, et Ithamar.
kjv: And the children of Amram; Aaron, and Moses, and Miriam. The sons also of Aaron; Nadab, and Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar.

wlc: בְּנֵי מְרָרִי מַחְלִי וּמֻשִׁי וְאֵלֶּה מִשְׁפְּחוֹת הַלֵּוִי לַאֲבוֹתֵיהֶם ׃
lxx: Ἐλεάζαρ ἐγέννησεν τὸν Φεινεές. Φεινεές ἐγέννησεν τὸν Ἀβεισού,
vulg: Eleazar genuit Finees et Finees genuit Abisue
clem: Eleazar genuit Phinees, et Phinees genuit Abisue.
kjv: Eleazar begat Phinehas, Phinehas begat Abishua,

wlc: לְגֵרְשׁוֹם לִבְנִי בְנוֹ יַחַת בְּנוֹ זִמָּה בְנוֹ ׃
lxx: Aβεισοὺ ἐγέννησεν τὸν Βωέ, καὶ Βωὲ ἐγέννησεν τὸν Ὀζεί,
vulg: Abisue vero genuit Bocci et Bocci genuit Ozi
clem: Abisue vero genuit Bocci, et Bocci genuit Ozi.
kjv: And Abishua begat Bukki, and Bukki begat Uzzi,

wlc: יוֹאָח בְּנוֹ עִדּוֹ בְנוֹ זֶרַח בְּנוֹ יְאָתְרַי בְּנוֹ ׃
lxx: Ὀζεὶ ἐγέννησε τὸν Ζαραιά, Ζαραιὰ ἐγέννησεν τὸν Μαρειήλ,
vulg: Ozi genuit Zaraiam et Zaraias genuit Meraioth
clem: Ozi genuit Zaraiam, et Zaraias genuit Meraioth.
kjv: And Uzzi begat Zerahiah, and Zerahiah begat Meraioth,

wlc: בְּנֵי קְהָת עַמִּינָדָב בְּנוֹ קֹרַח בְּנוֹ אַסִּיר בְּנוֹ ׃
lxx: καὶ Μαρειὴλ ἐγέννησεν τὸν Ἀμαρειά, καὶ Αμαρειὰ ἐγέννησεν τὸν Ἀχειτώβ,
vulg: porro Meraioth genuit Amariam et Amarias genuit Ahitob
clem: Porro Meraioth genuit Amariam, et Amarias genuit Achitob.
kjv: Meraioth begat Amariah, and Amariah begat Ahitub,

wlc: אֶלְקָנָה בְנוֹ וְאֶבְיָסָף בְּנוֹ וְאַסִּיר בְּנוֹ ׃
lxx: καὶ Ἀχειτὼβ ἐγέννησεν τὸν Σαδώκ, καὶ Σαδὼκ ἐγέννησεν τὸν Ἀχειμάας,
vulg: Ahitob genuit Sadoc Sadoc genuit Achimaas
clem: Achitob genuit Sadoc, et Sadoc genuit Achimaas,
kjv: And Ahitub begat Zadok, and Zadok begat Ahimaaz,

wlc: תַּחַת בְּנוֹ אוּרִיאֵל בְּנוֹ עֻזִּיָּה בְנוֹ וְשָׁאוּל בְּנוֹ ׃
lxx: καὶ Ἀχειμάας ἐγέννησεν τὸν Ἀζαρία, καὶ Ἀζαρίας ἐγέννησεν τὸν Ἰωανάς,
vulg: Achimaas genuit Azariam Azarias genuit Iohanan
clem: Achimaas genuit Azariam, Azarias genuit Johanan,
kjv: And Ahimaaz begat Azariah, and Azariah begat Johanan,

wlc: וּבְנֵי אֶלְקָנָה עֲמָשַׂי וַאֲחִימוֹת ׃
lxx: καὶ Ἰωανὰς ἐγέννησεν τὸν Ἀζαρίαν· οὗτος ἱεράτευσεν ἐν τῷ οἴκῳ ᾧ ῳᾠκοδόμησεν Σαλωμὼν ἐν Ἰερουσαλήμ.
vulg: Iohanan genuit Azariam ipse est qui sacerdotio functus est in domo quam aedificavit Salomon in Hierusalem
clem: Johanan genuit Azariam: ipse est qui sacerdotio functus est in domo quam dificavit Salomon in Jerusalem.
kjv: And Johanan begat Azariah, (he it is that executed the priest's office in the temple that Solomon built in Jerusalem:)

wlc: אֶלְקָנָה בְּנוֹ אֶלְקָנָה צוֹפַי בְּנוֹ וְנַחַת בְּנוֹ ׃
lxx: καὶ ἐγέννησεν Ἀζαρία τὸν Ἀμαριά, καὶ Ἀμαριὰ ἐγέννησεν τὸν Ἀχειτώβ,
vulg: genuit autem Azarias Amariam et Amarias genuit Ahitob
clem: Genuit autem Azarias Amariam, et Amarias genuit Achitob,
kjv: And Azariah begat Amariah, and Amariah begat Ahitub,

wlc: אֱלִיאָב בְּנוֹ יְרֹחָם בְּנוֹ אֶלְקָנָה בְנוֹ ׃
lxx: καὶ Ἀχειτὼβ ἐγέννησεν τὸν Σαδώκ, καὶ Σαδὼκ ἐγέννησεν τὸν Σαλώμ,
vulg: Ahitob genuit Sadoc et Sadoc genuit Sellum
clem: Achitob genuit Sadoc, et Sadoc genuit Sellum,
kjv: And Ahitub begat Zadok, and Zadok begat Shallum,

wlc: וּבְנֵי שְׁמוּאֵל הַבְּכֹר וַשְׁנִי וַאֲבִיָּה ׃ ס
lxx: καὶ Σαλὼμ ἐγέννησεν τὸν Χελκείαν, καὶ Χελκείας ἐγέννησεν τὸν Ἀζαρία,
vulg: Sellum genuit Helciam et Helcias genuit Azariam
clem: Sellum genuit Helciam, et Helcias genuit Azariam,
kjv: And Shallum begat Hilkiah, and Hilkiah begat Azariah,

wlc: בְּנֵי מְרָרִי מַחְלִי לִבְנִי בְנוֹ שִׁמְעִי בְנוֹ עֻזָּה בְנוֹ ׃
lxx: καὶ Ἀζαρίας ἐγέννησεν τὸν Σαραία, καὶ Σαραίας ἐγέννησεν τὸν Ἰωσαδάκ.
vulg: Azarias genuit Saraiam et Saraias genuit Iosedec
clem: Azarias genuit Saraiam, et Saraias genuit Josedec.
kjv: And Azariah begat Seraiah, and Seraiah begat Jehozadak,

wlc: שִׁמְעָא בְנוֹ חַגִּיָּה בְנוֹ עֲשָׂיָה בְנוֹ ׃ פ
lxx: καὶ Ἰωσαδὰκ ἐπορεύθη ἐν τῇ μετοικίᾳ μετὰ Ἰούδα καὶ Ἰερουσαλὴμ ἐν χειρὶ Ναβουχοδονοσόρ.
vulg: porro Iosedec egressus est quando transtulit Dominus Iudam et Hierusalem per manus Nabuchodonosor
clem: Porro Josedec egressus est, quando transtulit Dominus Judam et Jerusalem per manus Nabuchodonosor.
kjv: And Jehozadak went into captivity, when the Lord carried away Judah and Jerusalem by the hand of Nebuchadnezzar.

wlc: וְאֵלֶּה אֲשֶׁר הֶעֱמִיד דָּוִיד עַל־יְדֵי־שִׁיר בֵּית יְהוָה מִמְּנוֹחַ הָאָרוֹן ׃
lxx: Υἰ ἱοὶ Λευεί Γεδσών, Καὰθ καὶ Μαραρεί.
vulg: filii ergo Levi Gersom Caath et Merari
clem: Filii ergo Levi: Gersom, Caath, et Merari.
kjv: The sons of Levi; Gershom, Kohath, and Merari.

wlc: וַיִּהְיוּ מְשָׁרְתִים לִפְנֵי מִשְׁכַּן אֹהֶל־מוֹעֵד בַּשִּׁיר עַד־בְּנוֹת שְׁלֹמֹה אֶת־בֵּית יְהוָה בִּירוּשָׁלָםִ וַיַּעַמְדוּ כְמִשְׁפָּטָם עַל־עֲבוֹדָתָם ׃
lxx: καὶ ταῦτα τὰ ὀνόματα τῶν υἱῶν Γεδσών· Λοβενεὶ καὶ Σεμεεί.
vulg: et haec nomina filiorum Gersom Lobeni et Semei
clem: Et hc nomina filiorum Gersom: Lobni, et Semei.
kjv: And these be the names of the sons of Gershom; Libni, and Shimei.

wlc: וְאֵלֶּה הָעֹמְדִים וּבְנֵיהֶם מִבְּנֵי הַקְּהָתִי הֵימָן הַמְשׁוֹרֵר בֶּן־יוֹאֵל בֶּן־שְׁמוּאֵל ׃
lxx: υἱοὶ Καάθ· Ἀμβρὰμ καὶ Ἰσσαάρ, Χεβρὼν καὶ Οζειήλ.
vulg: filii Caath Amram et Isaar et Hebron et Ozihel
clem: Filii Caath: Amram, et Isaar, et Hebron, et Oziel.
kjv: And the sons of Kohath were, Amram, and Izhar, and Hebron, and Uzziel.

wlc: בֶּן־אֶלְקָנָה בֶּן־יְרֹחָם בֶּן־אֱלִיאֵל בֶּן־תּוֹחַ ׃
lxx: υἱοὶ Μαραρεί Μοολεὶ καὶ Óμουσεί. καὶ αὗται αἱ πατριαὶ τοῦ Λευεὶ κατὰ πατριὰς αὐτῶν.
vulg: filii Merari Mooli et Musi hae autem cognationes Levi secundum familias eorum
clem: Filii Merari: Moholi et Musi. H autem cognationes Levi secundum familias eorum.
kjv: The sons of Merari; Mahli, and Mushi. And these are the families of the Levites according to their fathers.

wlc: בֶּן־צִיף בֶּן־אֶלְקָנָה בֶּן־מַחַת בֶּן־עֲמָשָׂי ׃
lxx: ῷ Γεδσών, τῷ Λοβενεὶυἱῷ αὐτοῦ, Íέεθ υἱὸς αὐτοῦ, Ζεμμὰ υἱὸς αὐτοῦ,
vulg: Gersom Lobeni filius eius Iaath filius eius Zamma filius eius
clem: Gersom: Lobni filius ejus, Jahath filius ejus, Zamma filius ejus,
kjv: Of Gershom; Libni his son, Jahath his son, Zimmah his son,

wlc: בֶּן־אֶלְקָנָה בֶּן־יוֹאֵל בֶּן־עֲזַרְיָה בֶּן־צְפַנְיָה ׃
lxx: Ἰωὰβ υἱὸς αὐτοῦ, Ἀδεὶ υἱὸς αὐτοῦ, Ἰαάρα υἱὸς αὐτοῦ, Ἰεθρεὶ υἱὸς αὐτοῦ.
vulg: Ioaa filius eius Addo filius eius Zara filius eius Iethrai filius eius
clem: Joah filius ejus, Addo filius ejus, Zara filius ejus, Jethrai filius ejus.
kjv: Joah his son, Iddo his son, Zerah his son, Jeaterai his son.

wlc: בֶּן־תַּחַת בֶּן־אַסִּיר בֶּן־אֶבְיָסָף בֶּן־קֹרַח ׃
lxx: υἱρὶ Καάθ· Ἀμειναδὰβ υἱὸς αὐτοῦ, Κόρε υἱὸς αὐτοῦ, Ἀρεσεὶ υἱὸς αὐτοῦ,
vulg: filii Caath Aminadab filius eius Core filius eius Asir filius eius
clem: Filii Caath: Aminadab filius ejus, Core filius ejus, Asir filius ejus,
kjv: The sons of Kohath; Amminadab his son, Korah his son, Assir his son,

wlc: בֶּן־יִצְהָר בֶּן־קְהָת בֶּן־לֵוִי בֶּן־יִשְׂרָאֵל ׃
lxx: Ἐλκανὰ καὶ Ἀβιαθὰρ υἱὸς αὐτοῦ, Ἀσερεὶ υἱὸς αὐτοῦ,
vulg: Helcana filius eius Abiasaph filius eius Asir filius eius
clem: Elcana filius ejus, Abiasaph filius ejus, Asir filius ejus,
kjv: Elkanah his son, and Ebiasaph his son, and Assir his son,

wlc: וְאָחִיו אָסָף הָעֹמֵד עַל־יְמִינוֹ אָסָף בֶּן־בֶּרֶכְיָהוּ בֶּן־שִׁמְעָא ׃
lxx: Κάαθ υἱὸς αὐτοῦ, Ὀριὴλ υἱὸς αὐτοῦ, Ὀζειὰ υἱὸς αὐτοῦ, Σαοὺλ υἱὸς αὐτοῦ.
vulg: Thaath filius eius Urihel filius eius Ozias filius eius Saul filius eius
clem: Thahath filius ejus, Uriel filius ejus, Ozias filius ejus, Saul filius ejus.
kjv: Tahath his son, Uriel his son, Uzziah his son, and Shaul his son.

wlc: בֶּן־מִיכָאֵל בֶּן־בַּעֲשֵׂיָה בֶּן־מַלְכִּיָּה ׃
lxx: καὶ υἱοὶ Ἐλκανά· Ἀμεσσεὶ καὶ Ἀλειμώθ,
vulg: filii Helcana Amasai et Ahimoth
clem: Filii Elcana, Amasai et Achimoth
kjv: And the sons of Elkanah; Amasai, and Ahimoth.

wlc: בֶּן־אֶתְנִי בֶן־זֶרַח בֶּן־עֲדָיָה ׃
lxx: Ἐλκανὰ υἱὸς αὐτοῦ, Σουφεὶ υἱὸς αὐτοῦ, Καῖναθ υἱὸς αὐτοῦ,
vulg: Helcana filii Helcana Sophai filius eius Naath filius eius
clem: et Elcana. Filii Elcana: Sophai filius ejus, Nahath filius ejus,
kjv: As for Elkanah: the sons of Elkanah; Zophai his son, and Nahath his son,

wlc: בֶּן־אֵיתָן בֶּן־זִמָּה בֶּן־שִׁמְעִי ׃
lxx: Ἐλιὰβ υἱὸς αὐτοῦ, Ἰδαέρ υἱὸς αὐτοῦ, Ἐλκανὰ υἱὸς αὐτοῦ.
vulg: Heliab filius eius Hieroam filius eius Helcana filius eius
clem: Eliab filius ejus, Jeroham filius ejus, Elcana filius ejus.
kjv: Eliab his son, Jeroham his son, Elkanah his son.

wlc: בֶּן־יַחַת בֶּן־גֵּרְשֹׁם בֶּן־לֵוִי ׃ ס
lxx: υἱοὶ Σαμουὴλ· ὁ πρωτότοκος Σανεὶ καὶ Ἀβιά.
vulg: filii Samuhel primogenitus Vasseni et Abia
clem: Filii Samuel: primogenitus Vasseni, et Abia.
kjv: And the sons of Samuel; the firstborn Vashni, and Abiah.

wlc: וּבְנֵי מְרָרִי אֲחֵיהֶם עַל־הַשְּׂמֹאול אֵיתָן בֶּן־קִישִׁי בֶּן־עַבְדִּי בֶּן־מַלּוּךְ ׃
lxx: υἱοὶ Λοβενεὶ υἱὸς αὐτοῦ, Σομεεὶ υἱὸς αὐτοῦ, Ὀζᾶ υἱὸς αὐτοῦ,
vulg: filii autem Merari Mooli Lobeni filius eius Semei filius eius Oza filius eius
clem: Filii autem Merari, Moholi: Lobni filius ejus, Semei filius ejus, Oza filius ejus,
kjv: The sons of Merari; Mahli, Libni his son, Shimei his son, Uzza his son,

wlc: בֶּן־חֲשַׁבְיָה בֶן־אֲמַצְיָה בֶּן־חִלְקִיָּה ׃
lxx: Σομεὰ υἱὸς αὐτοῦ, Ἀμὰ υἱὸς αὐτοῦ, Ἀσαβὰ υἱὸς αὐτοῦ.
vulg: Samaa filius eius Aggia filius eius Asaia filius eius
clem: Sammaa filius ejus, Haggia filius ejus, Asaia filius ejus.
kjv: Shimea his son, Haggiah his son, Asaiah his son.

wlc: בֶּן־אַמְצִי בֶן־בָּנִי בֶּן־שָׁמֶר ׃
lxx: Καὶ οὗτοι οὓς κατέστησεν Δαυεὶδ ἐπὶ χεῖρας ᾀδόντων ἐν οἴκῳ Κυρίου ἐν τῇ καταπαύσει τῆς κιβωτοῦ.
vulg: isti sunt quos constituit David super cantores domus Domini ex quo conlocata est arca
clem: Isti sunt quos constituit David super cantores domus Domini, ex quo collocata est arca:
kjv: And these are they whom David set over the service of song in the house of the Lord, after that the ark had rest.

wlc: בֶּן־מַחְלִי בֶּן־מוּשִׁי בֶּן־מְרָרִי בֶּן־לֵוִי ׃
lxx: καὶ ἦσαν λειτουργοῦντες ἐναντίον τῆς σκηνῆς οἴκου μαρτυρίου ἐν ὀργάνοις ἕως οὗ ᾠκοδόμησεν Σαλωμὼν τὸν οἶκον ἐν Ἰερουσαλήμ· καὶ ἔστησαν κατὰ τὴν κρίσιν αὐτῶν ἐπὶ τὰς λειτουργίας αὐτῶν.
vulg: et ministrabant coram tabernaculo testimonii canentes donec aedificaret Salomon domum Domini in Hierusalem stabant autem iuxta ordinem suum in ministerio
clem: et ministrabant coram tabernaculo testimonii, canentes donec dificaret Salomon domum Domini in Jerusalem: stabant autem juxta ordinem suum in ministerio.
kjv: And they ministered before the dwelling place of the tabernacle of the congregation with singing, until Solomon had built the house of the Lord in Jerusalem: and then they waited on their office according to their order.

wlc: ס וַאֲחֵיהֶם הַלְוִיִּם נְתוּנִים לְכָל־עֲבוֹדַת מִשְׁכַּן בֵּית הָאֱלֹהִים ׃
lxx: καὶ οὗτοι οἱ ἑστηκότες καὶ οἱ υἱοὶ αὐτῶν ἐκ τῶν υἱῶν τοῦ Καάθ· Ἀἱμὰν ὁ ψαλτῳ Ἰωήλ υἱοῦ Σαμουὴλ
vulg: hii vero sunt qui adsistebant cum filiis suis de filiis Caath Heman cantor filius Iohel filii Samuhel
clem: Hi vero sunt qui assistebant cum filiis suis, de filiis Caath, Hemam cantor filius Johel, filii Samuel,
kjv: And these are they that waited with their children. Of the sons of the Kohathites: Heman a singer, the son of Joel, the son of Shemuel,

wlc: וְאַהֲרֹן וּבָנָיו מַקְטִירִים עַל־מִזְבַּח הָעוֹלָה וְעַל־מִזְבַּח הַקְּטֹרֶת לְכֹל מְלֶאכֶת קֹדֶשׁ הַקֳּדָשִׁים וּלְכַפֵּר עַל־יִשְׂרָאֵל כְּכֹל אֲשֶׁר צִוָּה מֹשֶׁה עֶבֶד הָאֱלֹהִים ׃ פ
lxx: υἱοῦ Ἐλκανὰ υἱοῦ Ἠαὰλ υἱοῦ Ἐλειὴλ υἱοῦ φεῖε
vulg: filii Helcana filii Hieroam filii Helihel filii Thou
clem: filii Elcana, filii Jeroham, filii Eliel, filii Thohu,
kjv: The son of Elkanah, the son of Jeroham, the son of Eliel, the son of Toah,

wlc: וְאֵלֶּה בְּנֵי אַהֲרֹן אֶלְעָזָר בְּנוֹ פִּינְחָס בְּנוֹ אֲבִישׁוּעַ בְּנוֹ ׃
lxx: υἱοῦ Σοὺφ υἱοῦ Ελκανὰ υἱοῦ Μὲθ υἱοῦ Ἀμαθειοὸ
vulg: filii Suph filii Helcana filii Maath filii Amasai
clem: filii Suph, filii Elcana, filii Mahath, filii Amasai,
kjv: The son of Zuph, the son of Elkanah, the son of Mahath, the son of Amasai,

wlc: בֻּקִּי בְנוֹ עֻזִּי בְנוֹ זְרַחְיָה בְנוֹ ׃
lxx: υἱοῦ Ἐλκανὰ υἱοῦ Ἰωήλ υἱοῦ Ἀζαρία υἱοῦ Σαφανιὰ
vulg: filii Helcana filii Iohel filii Azariae filii Sophoniae
clem: filii Elcana, filii Johel, filii Azari, filii Sophoni,
kjv: The son of Elkanah, the son of Joel, the son of Azariah, the son of Zephaniah,

wlc: מְרָיוֹת בְּנוֹ אֲמַרְיָה בְנוֹ אֲחִיטוּב בְּנוֹ ׃
lxx: υἱοῦ Θάαθ υἱοῦ Ἀσεὶρ υἱοῦ Ἀβιασὰρ υἱοῦ Κόρε
vulg: filii Thaath filii Asir filii Abiasaph filii Core
clem: filii Thahath, filii Asir, filii Abiasaph, filii Core,
kjv: The son of Tahath, the son of Assir, the son of Ebiasaph, the son of Korah,

wlc: צָדוֹק בְּנוֹ אֲחִימַעַץ בְּנוֹ ׃ ס
lxx: υἱοῦ Ἰσσαὰρ υἱοῦ Καὰθ υἱοῦ Λευεὶ υἱοῦ Ἰσραήλ.
vulg: filii Isaar filii Caath filii Levi filii Israhel
clem: filii Isaar, filii Caath, filii Levi, filii Isral.
kjv: The son of Izhar, the son of Kohath, the son of Levi, the son of Israel.

wlc: וְאֵלֶּה מוֹשְׁבוֹתָם לְטִירוֹתָם בִּגְבוּלָם לִבְנֵי אַהֲרֹן לְמִשְׁפַּחַת הַקְּהָתִי כִּי לָהֶם הָיָה הַגּוֹרָל ׃
lxx: καὶ ἀδελφὸς αὐτοῦ Ἀσὰφ ὁ ἑστηκὼς ἐν δεξιᾷ αὐτοῦ· Ἀσὰφ υἱὸς Βαραχιὰ υἱοῦ Σαμαὰ
vulg: et fratres eius Asaph qui stabat a dextris eius Asaph filius Barachiae filii Samaa
clem: Et frater ejus Asaph, qui stabat a dextris ejus, Asaph filius Barachi, filii Samaa,
kjv: And his brother Asaph, who stood on his right hand, even Asaph the son of Berachiah, the son of Shimea,

wlc: וַיִּתְּנוּ לָהֶם אֶת־חֶבְרוֹן בְּאֶרֶץ יְהוּדָה וְאֶת־מִגְרָשֶׁיהָ סְבִיבֹתֶיהָ ׃
lxx: υἱοῦ Μειχαὴλ υἱοῦ Μαασαὶ υἱοῦ Μελχειὰ
vulg: filii Michahel filii Basiae filii Melchiae
clem: filii Michal, filii Basai, filii Melchi,
kjv: The son of Michael, the son of Baaseiah, the son of Malchiah,

wlc: וְאֶת־שְׂדֵה הָעִיר וְאֶת־חֲצֵרֶיהָ נָתְנוּ לְכָלֵב בֶּן־יְפֻנֶּה ׃ ס
lxx: υἱοῦ Ἀθανεὶ υἱοῦ Ζααραὶ υἱοῦ Ἀζειὰ
vulg: filii Athnai filii Zara filii Adaia
clem: filii Athanai, filii Zara, filii Adaia,
kjv: The son of Ethni, the son of Zerah, the son of Adaiah,

wlc: וְלִבְנֵי אַהֲרֹן נָתְנוּ אֶת־עָרֵי הַמִּקְלָט אֶת־חֶבְרוֹן וְאֶת־לִבְנָה וְאֶת־מִגְרָשֶׁיהָ וְאֶת־יַתִּר וְאֶת־אֶשְׁתְּמֹעַ וְאֶת־מִגְרָשֶׁיהָ ׃
lxx: υἱοῦ Αἰθὰν υἱοῦ Ζαμμὰμ υἱοῦ Σεμεεὶ
vulg: filii Ethan filii Zamma filii Semei
clem: filii Ethan, filii Zamma, filii Semei,
kjv: The son of Ethan, the son of Zimmah, the son of Shimei,

wlc: וְאֶת־חִילֵז וְאֶת־מִגְרָשֶׁיהָ אֶת־דְּבִיר וְאֶת־מִגְרָשֶׁיהָ ׃
lxx: υἱοῦ Ἦχα υἱοῦ Γεεδσὼν υἱοῦ Λευεί.
vulg: filii Ieth filii Gersom filii Levi
clem: filii Jeth, filii Gersom, filii Levi.
kjv: The son of Jahath, the son of Gershom, the son of Levi.

wlc: וְאֶת־עָשָׁן וְאֶת־מִגְרָשֶׁיהָ וְאֶת־בֵּית שֶׁמֶשׁ וְאֶת־מִגְרָשֶׁיהָ ׃ ס
lxx: καὶ υἱοὶ Μεραρεὶ ἀδελφοῦ αὐτῶν ἐξ ἀριστερῶν· Αἰθὰμ υἱὸς Κεισαὶ υἱοῦ Ἀβδεὶ υού Μαλὼχ
vulg: filii autem Merari fratres eorum ad sinistram Ethan filius Cusi filii Abdi filii Maloch
clem: Filii autem Merari fratres eorum, ad sinistram, Ethan filius Cusi, filii Abdi, filii Maloch,
kjv: And their brethren the sons of Merari stood on the left hand: Ethan the son of Kishi, the son of Abdi, the son of Malluch,

wlc: וּמִמַּטֵּה בִנְיָמִן אֶת־גֶּבַע וְאֶת־מִגְרָשֶׁיהָ וְאֶת־עָלֶמֶת וְאֶת־מִגְרָשֶׁיהָ וְאֶת־עֲנָתוֹת וְאֶת־מִגְרָשֶׁיהָ כָּל־עָרֵיהֶם שְׁלֹשׁ־עֶשְׂרֵה עִיר בְּמִשְׁפְּחוֹתֵיהֶם ׃ ס
lxx: υἱοῦ Ἀοεβεὶ
vulg: filii Asabiae filii Amasiae filii Helciae
clem: filii Hasabi, filii Amasi, filii Helci,
kjv: The son of Hashabiah, the son of Amaziah, the son of Hilkiah,

wlc: וְלִבְנֵי קְהָת הַנּוֹתָרִים מִמִּשְׁפַּחַת הַמַּטֶּה מִמַּחֲצִית מַטֵּה חֲצִי מְנַשֶּׁה בַּגּוֹרָל עָרִים עָשֶׂר ׃ ס
lxx: υἱοῦ Ἀμεσσειὰ υἱοῦ Βανεὶ υἱοῦ Σἐμμηρ
vulg: filii Amasai filii Bonni filii Somer
clem: filii Amasai, filii Boni, filii Somer,
kjv: The son of Amzi, the son of Bani, the son of Shamer,

wlc: וְלִבְנֵי גֵרְשׁוֹם לְמִשְׁפְּחוֹתָם מִמַּטֵּה יִשָׂשכָר וּמִמַּטֵּה אָשֵׁר וּמִמַּטֵּה נַפְתָּלִי וּמִמַּטֵּה מְנַשֶּׁה בַּבָּשָׁן עָרִים שְׁלֹשׁ עֶשְׂרֵה ׃ ס
lxx: υἱοῦ Μοολεὶ Μοσεὶ υἱοῦ Μερραρεὶ υἱοῦ Λευεί.
vulg: filii Mooli filii Musi filii Merari filii Levi
clem: filii Moholi, filii Musi, filii Merari, filii Levi.
kjv: The son of Mahli, the son of Mushi, the son of Merari, the son of Levi.

wlc: לִבְנֵי מְרָרִי לְמִשְׁפְּחוֹתָם מִמַּטֵּה רְאוּבֵן וּמִמַּטֵּה־גָד וּמִמַּטֵּה זְבוּלֻן בַּגּוֹרָל עָרִים שְׁתֵּים עֶשְׂרֵה ׃
lxx: Καὶ ἀδελφοὶ αὐτῶν κατʼ οἴκους πατριῶν αὐτῶν οἱ Λευεῖται δεδομένοι εἰς πᾶσαν ἐργασίαν λειτουργίας σκηνῆς οἴκου τοῦ θεοῦ,
vulg: fratres quoque eorum Levitae qui ordinati sunt in cunctum ministerium tabernaculi domus Domini
clem: Fratres quoque eorum Levit, qui ordinati sunt in cunctum ministerium tabernaculi domus Domini.
kjv: Their brethren also the Levites were appointed unto all manner of service of the tabernacle of the house of God.

wlc: וַיִּתְּנוּ בְנֵי־יִשְׂרָאֵל לַלְוִיִּם אֶת־הֶעָרִים וְאֶת־מִגְרְשֵׁיהֶם ׃
lxx: καὶ Ἀαρὼν καὶ οἱ υἱοὶ αὐτοῦ θυμιῶντες ἐπὶ τὸ θυσιαστήριον τῶν ὁλοκαυταωμάτων καὶ ἐπὶ τὸ θυσιαστήριον τῶν θυμιαμάτων εἰς πᾶσαν ἐργασίαν ἅγια τῶν ἁγίων καὶ ἐξιλάσκεσθαι περὶ Ἰσραὴλ κατὰ πάντα ὅσα ἐνετείλατο Μωυσῆς παῖς τοῦ θεοῦ.
vulg: Aaron vero et filii eius adolebant incensum super altare holocausti et super altare thymiamatis in omne opus sancti sanctorum et ut precarentur pro Israhel iuxta omnia quae praecepit Moses servus Dei
clem: Aaron vero et filii ejus adolebant incensum super altare holocausti, et super altare thymiamatis, in omne opus Sancti sanctorum: et ut precarentur pro Isral juxta omnia qu prceperat Moyses servus Dei.
kjv: But Aaron and his sons offered upon the altar of the burnt offering, and on the altar of incense, and were appointed for all the work of the place most holy, and to make an atonement for Israel, according to all that Moses the servant of God had commanded.

wlc: וַיִּתְּנוּ בַגּוֹרָל מִמַּטֵּה בְנֵי־יְהוּדָה וּמִמַּטֵּה בְנֵי־שִׁמְעוֹן וּמִמַּטֵּה בְּנֵי בִנְיָמִן אֵת הֶעָרִים הָאֵלֶּה אֲשֶׁר־יִקְרְאוּ אֶתְהֶם בְּשֵׁמוֹת ׃ ס
lxx: Καὶ οὗτοι υἱοὶ Ἀαρών· Ἐεαζαρ υἱὸς αὐτοῦ, Φεινεὲς υἱὸς αὐτοῦ, Ἀβεισοὺ υἱὸς αὐτοῦ,
vulg: hii sunt autem filii Aaron Eleazar filius eius Finees filius eius Abisue filius eius
clem: Hi sunt autem filii Aaron: Eleazar filius ejus, Phinees filius ejus, Abisue filius ejus,
kjv: And these are the sons of Aaron; Eleazar his son, Phinehas his son, Abishua his son,

wlc: וּמִמִּשְׁפְּחוֹת בְּנֵי קְהָת וַיְהִי עָרֵי גְבוּלָם מִמַּטֵּה אֶפְרָיִם ׃
lxx: Βωκαὶ υἱὸς αὐτοῦ, Ὀζεὶ υἱὸς αὐτοῦ, Ζαραιὰ υἱὸς αὐτοῦ,
vulg: Bocci filius eius Ozi filius eius Zaraia filius eius
clem: Bocci filius ejus, Ozi filius ejus, Zarahia filius ejus,
kjv: Bukki his son, Uzzi his son, Zerahiah his son,

wlc: וַיִּתְּנוּ לָהֶם אֶת־עָרֵי הַמִּקְלָט אֶת־שְׁכֶם וְאֶת־מִגְרָשֶׁיהָ בְּהַר אֶפְרָיִם וְאֶת־גֶּזֶר וְאֶת־מִגְרָשֶׁיהָ ׃
lxx: Μαρειὴλ υἱὸς αὐτοῦ, Ἀλιαρειὰ υἱὸς αὐτοῦ, Ἀχειτὼβ υἱὸς αὐτοῦ,
vulg: Meraioth filius eius Amaria filius eius Ahitob filius eius
clem: Meraioth filius ejus, Amarias filius ejus, Achitob filius ejus,
kjv: Meraioth his son, Amariah his son, Ahitub his son,

wlc: וְאֶת־יָקְמְעָם וְאֶת־מִגְרָשֶׁיהָ וְאֶת־בֵּית חוֹרוֹן וְאֶת־מִגְרָשֶׁיהָ ׃
lxx: Σαδὼκ υἱὸς αὐτοῦ, Ἀχεισάμα υἱὸς αὐτοῦ.
vulg: Sadoc filius eius Achimaas filius eius
clem: Sadoc filius ejus, Achimaas filius ejus.
kjv: Zadok his son, Ahimaaz his son.

wlc: וְאֶת־אַיָּלוֹן וְאֶת־מִגְרָשֶׁיהָ וְאֶת־גַּת־רִמּוֹן וְאֶת־מִגְרָשֶׁיהָ ׃ פ
lxx: Καὶ αὗται αἱ κατοικίαι αὐτῶν ἐν ταῖς κώμαις αὐτῶν ἐν τοῖς ὁρίοις αὐτῶν τοῖς υἱοῖς Ἀαρὼν τῇ πατρίᾷ αὐτῶν τοῦ Κααθεί, ὅτι αὐτοῖς ἐγένετο ὁ κλῆρος.
vulg: et haec habitacula eorum per vicos atque confinia filiorum scilicet Aaron iuxta cognationes Caathitarum ipsis enim sorte contigerat
clem: Et hc habitacula eorum per vicos atque confinia, filiorum scilicet Aaron, juxta cognationes Caathitarum: ipsis enim sorte contigerant.
kjv: Now these are their dwelling places throughout their castles in their coasts, of the sons of Aaron, of the families of the Kohathites: for theirs was the lot.

wlc: וּמִמַּחֲצִית מַטֵּה מְנַשֶּׁה אֶת־עָנֵר וְאֶת־מִגְרָשֶׁיהָ וְאֶת־בִּלְעָם וְאֶת־מִגְרָשֶׁיהָ לְמִשְׁפַּחַת לִבְנֵי־קְהָת הַנּוֹתָרִים ׃ פ
lxx: καὶ ἔδωκαν αὐτοῖς τὴν Χεβρὼν ἐν τῇ Ἰουδαίᾳ καὶ τὰ περισπόρια αὐτῆς κύκλῳ αὐτῆς.
vulg: dederunt igitur eis Hebron in terra Iuda et suburbana eius per circuitum
clem: Dederunt igitur eis Hebron in terra Juda, et suburbana ejus per circuitum:
kjv: And they gave them Hebron in the land of Judah, and the suburbs thereof round about it.

wlc: לִבְנֵי גֵּרְשׁוֹם מִמִּשְׁפַּחַת חֲצִי מַטֵּה מְנַשֶּׁה אֶת־גּוֹלָן בַּבָּשָׁן וְאֶת־מִגְרָשֶׁיהָ וְאֶת־עַשְׁתָּרוֹת וְאֶת־מִגְרָשֶׁיהָ ׃ ס
lxx: καὶ τὰ πεδία τῆς πόλεως καὶ τὰς κώμας αὐτῆς ἔδωκαν τῷ Χαλέβ υἱῷ Ἰεφοννή.
vulg: agros autem civitatis et villas Chaleb filio Iephonne
clem: agros autem civitatis, et villas, Caleb filio Jephone.
kjv: But the fields of the city, and the villages thereof, they gave to Caleb the son of Jephunneh.

wlc: וּמִמַּטֵּה יִשָׂשכָר אֶת־קֶדֶשׁ וְאֶת־מִגְרָשֶׁיהָ אֶת־דָּבְרַת וְאֶת־מִגְרָשֶׁיהָ ׃
lxx: καὶ τοῖς υἱοῖς Ἀαρὼν ἔδωκαν τὰς πόλεις τῶν φυγαδευτηρίων, τὴν Χεβρών, καὶ τὴν Λοβνὰ καὶ τὰ περισπόρια αὐτῆς, καὶ τὴν Σελνὰ καὶ τὰ περισπόρια αὐτῆς, καὶ τὴν Ἐσθαμὼ καὶ τὰ περισπόρια αὐτῆς,
vulg: porro filiis Aaron dederunt civitates ad confugiendum Hebron et Lobna et suburbana eius
clem: Porro filiis Aaron dederunt civitates ad confugiendum Hebron, et Lobna, et suburbana ejus,
kjv: And to the sons of Aaron they gave the cities of Judah, namely, Hebron, the city of refuge, and Libnah with her suburbs, and Jattir, and Eshtemoa, with their suburbs,

wlc: וְאֶת־רָאמוֹת וְאֶת־מִגְרָשֶׁיהָ וְאֶת־עָנֵם וְאֶת־מִגְרָשֶׁיהָ ׃ ס
lxx: καὶ τὰ Ἰεθθὰρ καὶ τὰ περισπόρια αὐτῆς, καὶ τὴν Δαβεὶρ καὶ τά περισπόρια αὐτῆς,
vulg: Iether quoque et Esthmo cum suburbanis suis sed et Helon et Dabir cum suburbanis suis
clem: Jether quoque, et Esthemo cum suburbanis suis, sed et Helon, et Dabir cum suburbanis suis,
kjv: And Hilen with her suburbs, Debir with her suburbs,

wlc: וּמִמַּטֵּה אָשֵׁר אֶת־מָשָׁל וְאֶת־מִגְרָשֶׁיהָ וְאֶת־עַבְדּוֹן וְאֶת־מִגְרָשֶׁיהָ ׃
lxx: καὶ τὴν Ἀσὰν καὶ τὰ περισπόρια αὐτῆς, καὶ τὴν Αττὰν καὶ τὰ περσπόρια αὐτῆς, καὶ τὴν Βασάμυς·
vulg: Asan quoque et Bethsemes et suburbana eorum
clem: Asan quoque, et Bethsemes, et suburbana earum.
kjv: And Ashan with her suburbs, and Bethshemesh with her suburbs:

wlc: וְאֶת־חוּקֹק וְאֶת־מִגְרָשֶׁיהָ וְאֶת־רְחֹב וְאֶת־מִגְרָשֶׁיהָ ׃
lxx: καὶ ἐκ φυλῆς Βενιαμεὶν καὶ τὴν Γάβαι καὶ τά περισπόρια αὐτῆς, καὶ τὴν Γαλέμεθ καὶ τὰ περισπόρια αὐτῆς, καὶ τὴν Ἀγχῶχ καὶ τά περισπόρια αὐτῆς· πᾶσαι αἱ πόλεις αὐτῶν τρισκαίδεκα πόλεις κατά πατριὰς αὐτῶν.
vulg: de tribu autem Beniamin Gabee et suburbana eius et Almath cum suburbanis suis Anathoth quoque cum suburbanis suis omnes civitates tredecim per cognationes suas
clem: De tribu autem Benjamin, Gabee et suburbana ejus, et Almath cum suburbanis suis, Anathoth quoque cum suburbanis suis: omnes civitates, tredecim, per cognationes suas.
kjv: And out of the tribe of Benjamin; Geba with her suburbs, and Alemeth with her suburbs, and Anathoth with her suburbs. All their cities throughout their families were thirteen cities.

wlc: וּמִמַּטֵּה נַפְתָּלִי אֶת־קֶדֶשׁ בַּגָּלִיל וְאֶת־מִגְרָשֶׁיהָ וְאֶת־חַמּוֹן וְאֶת־מִגְרָשֶׁיהָ וְאֶת־קִרְיָתַיִם וְאֶת־מִגְרָשֶׁיהָ ׃ ס
lxx: καὶ τοῖς υἱοῖς Καάθ τοῖς καταλοίποις ἐκ τῶν πατριῶν ἐκ τῆς φυλῆς ἐκ τοῦ ἡμίσους φυλῆς Μανασσὴ κλήρῳ πόλεις δέκα.
vulg: filiis autem Caath residuis de cognatione sua dederunt ex dimidia tribu Manasse in possessionem urbes decem
clem: Filiis autem Caath residuis de cognatione sua dederunt ex dimidia tribu Manasse in possessionem urbes decem.
kjv: And unto the sons of Kohath, which were left of the family of that tribe, were cities given out of the half tribe, namely, out of the half tribe of Manasseh, by lot, ten cities.

wlc: לִבְנֵי מְרָרִי הַנּוֹתָרִים מִמַּטֵּה זְבוּלֻן אֶת־רִמּוֹנוֹ וְאֶת־מִגְרָשֶׁיהָ אֶת־תָּבוֹר וְאֶת־מִגְרָשֶׁיהָ ׃
lxx: καὶ τοῖς υἱοῖς Γεδσὼν κατὰ πατριὰς αὐτῶν ἐκ φυλῆς Ἰσσαχὰρ, ἐκ φυλῆς Ἀσήρ, ἐκ φυλῆς Nεφθαλεί, ἐκ φυλῆς Μανασσὴ ἐν τῇ Βασὰν πόλεις τρισκαίδεκα.
vulg: porro filiis Gersom per cognationes suas de tribu Isachar et de tribu Aser et de tribu Nepthali et de tribu Manasse in Basan urbes tredecim
clem: Porro filiis Gersom per cognationes suas de tribu Issachar, et de tribu Aser, et de tribu Nephthali, et de tribu Manasse in Basan, urbes tredecim.
kjv: And to the sons of Gershom throughout their families out of the tribe of Issachar, and out of the tribe of Asher, and out of the tribe of Naphtali, and out of the tribe of Manasseh in Bashan, thirteen cities.

wlc: וּמֵעֵבֶר לְיַרְדֵּן יְרֵחוֹ לְמִזְרַח הַיַּרְדֵּן מִמַּטֵּה רְאוּבֵן אֶת־בֶּצֶר בַּמִּדְבָּר וְאֶת־מִגְרָשֶׁיהָ וְאֶת־יַהְצָה וְאֶת־מִגְרָשֶׁיהָ ׃
lxx: καὶ τοῖς υἱοῖς Μεραρεὶ κατὰ πατριὰς αὐτῶν ἐκ φυλῆς Ῥουβὴν, ἐκ φυλῆς Δάν, ἐκ φυλῆς Ζαβουλὼν κλήρῳ πόλεις δέκα δύο.
vulg: filiis autem Merari per cognationes suas de tribu Ruben et de tribu Gad et de tribu Zabulon dederunt sorte civitates duodecim
clem: Filiis autem Merari per cognationes suas de tribu Ruben, et de tribu Gad, et de tribu Zabulon, dederunt sorte civitates duodecim.
kjv: Unto the sons of Merari were given by lot, throughout their families, out of the tribe of Reuben, and out of the tribe of Gad, and out of the tribe of Zebulun, twelve cities.

wlc: וְאֶת־קְדֵמוֹת וְאֶת־מִגְרָשֶׁיהָ וְאֶת־מֵיפַעַת וְאֶת־מִגְרָשֶׁיהָ ׃
lxx: καὶ ἔδωκαν οἱ υἱκρὶ Ἰσραὴλ τοῖς Λευείταις τὰς πόλεις καὶ τὰ περισπόρια οὐτῶν·
vulg: dederunt quoque filii Israhel Levitis civitates et suburbana earum
clem: Dederunt quoque filii Isral Levitis civitates, et suburbana earum:
kjv: And the children of Israel gave to the Levites these cities with their suburbs.

wlc: וּמִמַּטֵּה־גָד אֶת־רָאמוֹת בַּגִּלְעָד וְאֶת־מִגְרָשֶׁיהָ וְאֶת־מַחֲנַיִם וְאֶת־מִגְרָשֶׁיהָ ׃
lxx: καὶ ἔδωκαν ἐν κλήρῳ ἐκ φυλῆς υἱῶν Ἰούδα καὶ ἐκ φυλῆς υἱῶν Συμεὼν τὰς πόλεις ταύτας ἃ ἐκάλεσεν αὐτάς.
vulg: dederuntque per sortem ex tribu filiorum Iuda et ex tribu filiorum Symeon et ex tribu filiorum Beniamin urbes has quas vocaverunt nominibus suis
clem: dederuntque per sortem, ex tribu filiorum Juda, et ex tribu filiorum Simeon, et ex tribu filiorum Benjamin urbes has, quas vocaverunt nominibus suis,
kjv: And they gave by lot out of the tribe of the children of Judah, and out of the tribe of the children of Simeon, and out of the tribe of the children of Benjamin, these cities, which are called by their names.

wlc: וְאֶת־חֶשְׁבּוֹן וְאֶת־מִגְרָשֶׁיהָ וְאֶת־יַעְזֵיר וְאֶת־מִגְרָשֶׁיהָ ׃ ס
lxx: καὶ ἀπὸ τῶν πατριῶν υἱῶν Καάθ, καὶ ἐγένοντο πόλεις τῶν ὁρίων αὐτῶν ἐκ φυλῆς Ἐφράιμ.
vulg: et his qui erant ex cognatione filiorum Caath fueruntque civitates in terminis eorum de tribu Ephraim
clem: et his, qui erant de cognatione filiorum Caath, fueruntque civitates in terminis eorum de tribu Ephraim.
kjv: And the residue of the families of the sons of Kohath had cities of their coasts out of the tribe of Ephraim.

lxx: καὶ ἔδωκαν αὐτῷ τὰς πόλεις τῶν φυγαδευτηρίων, τὴν Συχἐμ καὶ τὰ περισπόρια αὐτῆς ἐν ὄρει Ἐφράιμ, καὶ τὴν Γάζερ καὶ τὰ περισπόρια αὐτῆς,
vulg: dederunt ergo eis urbes ad confugiendum Sychem cum suburbanis suis in monte Ephraim et Gazer cum suburbanis suis
clem: Dederunt ergo eis urbes ad confugiendum, Sichem cum suburbanis suis in monte Ephraim, et Gazer cum suburbanis suis,
kjv: And they gave unto them, of the cities of refuge, Shechem in mount Ephraim with her suburbs; they gave also Gezer with her suburbs,

lxx: καὶ τὴν Ἰκαὰμ καὶ τὰ περισπόρια αὐτῆς, καὶ τὴν Βαιθώρων καὶ τὰ περισπόρια αὐτῆς,
vulg: Hicmaam quoque cum suburbanis suis et Bethoron similiter
clem: Jecmaam quoque cum suburbanis suis, et Bethoron similiter,
kjv: And Jokmeam with her suburbs, and Bethhoron with her suburbs,

lxx: καὶ τὴν Ἐγλὰμ καὶ τὰ περισπόρια αὐτῆς, καὶ τὴν Γεθωρὼν καὶ τὰ περισπόρια αὐτῆς·
vulg: necnon et Helon cum suburbanis suis et Gethremmon in eundem modum
clem: necnon et Helon cum suburbanis suis, et Gethremmon in eumdem modum.
kjv: And Aijalon with her suburbs, and Gathrimmon with her suburbs:

lxx: καὶ ἀπὸ τῶν ἡμίσους φυλῆς Μανασσὴ τὴν Ἀμὰρ καὶ τὰ περισπόρια αὐτῆς, κατὰ πατριὰν τοῖς υἱοῖς Καὰθ τοῖς καταλοίποις.
vulg: porro ex dimidia tribu Manasse Aner et suburbana eius Balaam et suburbana eius his videlicet qui de cognatione filiorum Caath reliqui erant
clem: Porro ex dimidia tribu Manasse, Aner et suburbana ejus, Balaam et suburbana ejus: his videlicet, qui de cognatione filiorum Caath reliqui erant.
kjv: And out of the half tribe of Manasseh; Aner with her suburbs, and Bileam with her suburbs, for the family of the remnant of the sons of Kohath.

lxx: τοῖς υἱοῖς Γεδσὼν ἀπὸ πατριῶν ἡμίσους φυλῆς Μανασσὴ τὴν Γωλὰν ἐκ τῆς Βασὰν καὶ τὰ περιπόλια αὐτῆς, καὶ τὴν Ἀσηρὼθ καὶ τὰ περισπόρια αὐτῆς·
vulg: filiis autem Gersom de cognatione dimidiae tribus Manasse Gaulon in Basan et suburbana eius et Astharoth cum suburbanis suis
clem: Filiis autem Gersom de cognatione dimidi tribus Manasse, Gaulon in Basan, et suburbana ejus, et Astaroth cum suburbanis suis.
kjv: Unto the sons of Gershom were given out of the family of the half tribe of Manasseh, Golan in Bashan with her suburbs, and Ashtaroth with her suburbs:

lxx: καὶ ἐκ φυλῆς Ἰσσαχὰρ τὴν Κέδες καὶ τὰ περισπόρια αὐτῆς, καὶ τὴν Δεβερεὶ καὶ τά περισπόρια αὐτῆς, καὶ τὴν Δαβὼρ καὶ τά περισπόρια αὐτῆς·
vulg: de tribu Isachar Cedes et suburbana eius et Dabereth cum suburbanis suis
clem: De tribu Issachar, Cedes et suburbanis suis, et Dabereth cum suburbanis suis,
kjv: And out of the tribe of Issachar; Kedesh with her suburbs, Daberath with her suburbs,

vulg: Ramoth quoque et suburbana illius et Anem cum suburbanis suis
clem: Ramoth quoque et suburbana ejus, et Anem cum suburbanis suis.
kjv: And Ramoth with her suburbs, and Anem with her suburbs:

lxx: καὶ ἐκ φυλῆς Ἀσὴρ τὴν Μαασά καὶ τά περισπόρια αὐτῆς, καὶ τὴν Ἀβαρὰν καὶ τὰ περισπορια αὐτῆς,
vulg: de tribu vero Aser Masal cum suburbanis suis et Abdon similiter
clem: De tribu vero Aser: Masal cum suburbanis suis, et Abdon similiter,
kjv: And out of the tribe of Asher; Mashal with her suburbs, and Abdon with her suburbs,

lxx: καὶ τὴν Ἰκὰκ καὶ τὰ περισπόρια αὐτῆς, καὶ τὴν Ῥοὼβ καὶ τὰ περισπόρια αὐτῆς·
vulg: Acac quoque et suburbana eius et Roob cum suburbanis suis
clem: Hucac quoque et suburbana ejus, et Rohob cum suburbanis suis.
kjv: And Hukok with her suburbs, and Rehob with her suburbs:

lxx: καὶ ἀπὸ φυλῆς Nεφθαλεὶ τὴν Κέδες ἐν τῇ Γαλειλαίᾳ καὶτὰ περισπόρια αὐτῆς, καὶ τὴν Χαμὼθ καὶ τὰ περισπόρια αὐτῆς, καὶ τὴν Καριαθάιμ καὶ τὰ περισπόρια αὐτῆς.
vulg: porro de tribu Nepthali Cedes in Galilea et suburbana eius Amon cum suburbanis suis et Cariathaim et suburbana eius
clem: Porro de tribu Nephthali, Cedes in Galila et suburbana ejus, Hamon cum suburbanis suis, et Cariathaim et suburbana ejus.
kjv: And out of the tribe of Naphtali; Kedesh in Galilee with her suburbs, and Hammon with her suburbs, and Kirjathaim with her suburbs.

lxx: τοῖς υἱοῖς Μεραρεὶ τοῖς καταλοίποις ἐκ φυλῆς Ζαβουλὼν τὴν Ῥεμμὼν καὶ τὰ περισπόρια αὐτῆς, καὶ τὴν Θαχχειὰ καὶ τὰ περισπόρια αὐτῆς
vulg: filiis autem Merari residuis de tribu Zabulon Remmono et suburbana eius et Thabor cum suburbanis suis
clem: Filiis autem Merari residuis: de tribu Zabulon, Remmono et suburbana ejus, et Thabor cum suburbanis sus:
kjv: Unto the rest of the children of Merari were given out of the tribe of Zebulun, Rimmon with her suburbs, Tabor with her suburbs:

lxx: ἐκ τοῦ πέραν τοῦ Ἰορδάνου, καὶ τὴν Ἰερειχὼ κατὰ δυσμὰς τοῦ Ἰορδάνου· ἐκ φυλῆς Ῥουβὴν τὴν Βοσὸρ ἐν τῇ ἐρήμῳ καὶ τὰ περισπόρια αὐτῆς,
vulg: trans Iordanem quoque ex adverso Hiericho contra orientem Iordanis de tribu Ruben Bosor in solitudine cum suburbanis suis et Iasa cum suburbanis suis
clem: trans Jordanem quoque ex adverso Jericho contra orientem Jordanis, de tribu Ruben, Bosor in solitudine cum suburbanis suis, et Jassa cum suburbanis suis,
kjv: And on the other side Jordan by Jericho, on the east side of Jordan, were given them out of the tribe of Reuben, Bezer in the wilderness with her suburbs, and Jahzah with her suburbs,

lxx: καὶ τὴν Καδαμὼς καὶ τὰ περισπόρια αὐτῆς, καὶ τὴν Μαέφλα καὶ τὰ περισπόρια αὐτῆς·
vulg: Cademoth quoque et suburbana eius et Miphaath cum suburbanis suis
clem: Cademoth quoque et suburbana ejus, et Mephaat cum suburbanis suis.
kjv: Kedemoth also with her suburbs, and Mephaath with her suburbs:

lxx: καὶ ἐκ φυλῆς Γὰδ τὴν Ῥαμμὼν Γαλαὰδ καὶ τὰ περισπόρια αὐτῆς, καὶ τὴν Μαανάιθ καὶ τὰ περισπόρια αὐτῆς,
vulg: necnon de tribu Gad Ramoth in Galaad et suburbana eius et Manaim cum suburbanis suis
clem: Necnon et de tribu Gad, Ramoth in Galaad et suburbana ejus, et Manaim cum suburbanis suis,
kjv: And out of the tribe of Gad; Ramoth in Gilead with her suburbs, and Mahanaim with her suburbs,

lxx: καὶ τὴν Ἐσεβαὼν καὶ τὰ τπερισπόρια αὐτῆς, καὶ τὴν Γαζέρ καὶ τὰ περισπόρια αὐτῆς.
vulg: sed et Esbon cum suburbanis eius et Iezer cum suburbanis suis
clem: sed et Hesebon cum suburbanis suis, et Jezer cum suburbanis suis.
kjv: And Heshbon with her suburbs, and Jazer with her suburbs.

wlc: וְלִבְנֵי יִשָׂשכָר תּוֹלָע וּפוּאָה יָשִׁיב וְשִׁמְרוֹן אַרְבָּעָה ׃ ס
lxx: Καὶ τοῖς υἱρῖς Ἰσσαχὰρ· Θολάεκ καὶ Φοὐτ καὶ Ἰασσοὺρ καὶ Σεμερών, τέσσαρες.
vulg: porro filii Isachar Thola et Phua Iasub et Samaron quattuor
clem: Porro filii Issachar: Thola, et Phua, Jasub, et Simeron, quatuor.
kjv: Now the sons of Issachar were, Tola, and Puah, Jashub, and Shimrom, four.

wlc: וּבְנֵי תוֹלָע עֻזִּי וּרְפָיָה וִירִיאֵל וְיַחְמַי וְיִבְשָׂם וּשְׁמוּאֵל רָאשִׁים לְבֵית־אֲבוֹתָם לְתוֹלָע גִּבּוֹרֵי חַיִל לְתֹלְדוֹתָם מִסְפָּרָם בִּימֵי דָוִיד עֶשְׂרִים־וּשְׁנַיִם אֶלֶף וְשֵׁשׁ מֵאוֹת ׃ ס
lxx: καὶ υἱοὶ Uολέ· Ὀζεί, Ῥαφαρὰ καὶ Ῥειὴλ καὶ Εἰικάν, Βασὰν καὶ Ἰσαμουήλ, ἄρχοντες οἴκων πατριῶν αὐτῶν τῷ Θωλαεὶ ἰσχυροὶ δυνάμει κατὰ γενέσεις αὐτῶν. ὁ ἀριθμὸς αὐτῶν ἡμέραις Δαυεὶδ εἴκοσι καὶ δύο χιλιάδες καὶ ἑξακόσιοι.
vulg: filii Thola Ozi et Raphaia et Ierihel et Iemai et Iebsem et Samuhel principes per domos cognationum suarum de stirpe Thola viri fortissimi numerati sunt in diebus David viginti duo milia sescenti
clem: Filii Thola: Ozi, et Raphaia, et Jeriel, et Jemai, et Jebsem, et Samuel, principes per domos cognationum suarum. De stirpe Thola viri fortissimi numerati sunt in diebus David, viginti duo millia sexcenti.
kjv: And the sons of Tola; Uzzi, and Rephaiah, and Jeriel, and Jahmai, and Jibsam, and Shemuel, heads of their father's house, to wit, of Tola: they were valiant men of might in their generations; whose number was in the days of David two and twenty thousand and six hundred.

wlc: וּבְנֵי עֻזִּי יִזְרַחְיָה וּבְנֵי יִזְרַחְיָה מִיכָאֵל וְעֹבַדְיָה וְיוֹאֵל יִשִּׁיָּה חֲמִשָּׁה רָאשִׁים כֻּלָּם ׃
lxx: καὶ υἱοὶ Ζειρρεί Σαρειά, Μειχαήλ· καὶ υἱοὶ Ζαρειὰ Μειβδειὰ καὶ Ῥαήλ, Εἰσιά, πέντε, ἄρχοντες πάντες.
vulg: filii Ozi Iezraia de quo nati sunt Michahel et Obadia et Iohel et Iesia quinque omnes principes
clem: Filii Ozi: Izrahia, de quo nati sunt Michal, et Obadia, et Jol, et Jesia, quinque omnes principes.
kjv: And the sons of Uzzi; Izrahiah: and the sons of Izrahiah; Michael, and Obadiah, and Joel, Ishiah, five: all of them chief men.

wlc: וַעֲלֵיהֶם לְתֹלְדוֹתָם לְבֵית אֲבוֹתָם גְּדוּדֵי צְבָא מִלְחָמָה שְׁלֹשִׁים וְשִׁשָּׁה אָלֶף כִּי־הִרְבּוּ נָשִׁים וּבָנִים ׃
lxx: καὶ ἐπʼ αὐτῶν κατὰ γενέσεις αὐτῶν κατʼ οἴκους πατρικοὺς αὐτῶν ἰσχυροὶ παρατάξασθαι εἰς πόλεμον τριάκοντα καὶ ἓξ χιλιάδες, ὅτι ἐπλήθυναν γυναῖκας καὶ υἱούς.
vulg: cumque eis per familias et populos suos accincti ad proelium viri fortissimi triginta sex milia multas enim habuere uxores et filios
clem: Cumque eis per familias et populos suos, accincti ad prlium, viri fortissimi, triginta sex millia: multas enim habuerunt uxores, et filios.
kjv: And with them, by their generations, after the house of their fathers, were bands of soldiers for war, six and thirty thousand men: for they had many wives and sons.

wlc: וַאֲחֵיהֶם לְכֹל מִשְׁפְּחוֹת יִשָׂשכָר גִּבּוֹרֵי חֲיָלִים שְׁמוֹנִים וְשִׁבְעָה אֶלֶף הִתְיַחְשָׂם לַכֹּל ׃ פ
lxx: καὶ ἀδελφοὶ αὐτῶν εἰς πάσας πατριὰς Ἰσσαχὰρ καὶ ἰσχυροὶ δυνάμει ὁγδοήκοντα καὶ ἑπτὰ χιλιάδες, ὁ ἀριθμὸς αὐτῶν τῶν πάντων.
vulg: fratresque eorum per omnem cognationem Isachar robustissimi ad pugnandum octoginta septem milia numerati sunt
clem: Fratres quoque eorum per omnem cognationem Issachar robustissimi ad pugnandum, octoginta septem millia numerati sunt.
kjv: And their brethren among all the families of Issachar were valiant men of might, reckoned in all by their genealogies fourscore and seven thousand.

wlc: בִּנְיָמִן בֶּלַע וָבֶכֶר וִידִיעֲאֵל שְׁלֹשָׁה ׃
lxx: Βενιαμεὶν καὶ Ἀβειρὰ καὶ Ἀδειήλ, τρεῖς.
vulg: Beniamin Bale et Bochor et Iadihel tres
clem: Filii Benjamin: Bela, et Bechor, et Jadihel, tres.
kjv: The sons of Benjamin; Bela, and Becher, and Jediael, three.

wlc: וּבְנֵי בֶלַע אֶצְבּוֹן וְעֻזִּי וְעֻזִּיאֵל וִירִימוֹת וְעִירִי חֲמִשָּׁה רָאשֵׁי בֵּית אָבוֹת גִּבּוֹרֵי חֲיָלִים וְהִתְיַחְשָׂם עֶשְׂרִים וּשְׁנַיִם אֶלֶף וּשְׁלֹשִׁים וְאַרְבָּעָה ׃ ס
lxx: καὶ υἱοὶ Βάδεε· Ἀσεβὼν καὶ Οζεὶ καὶ Οζειὴλ καὶ Ἀρειμώθ, Οὐρεί, πέντε, ἄρχοντες οἴκων πατρικῶν ἰσχυροὶ δυνάμει, καὶ ὁ ἀριθμὸς αὐτῶν εἴκοσι καὶ δύο χιλιάδες καὶ τριάκοντα τέσσαρες.
vulg: filii Bale Esbon et Ozi et Ozihel et Ierimoth et Urai quinque principes familiarum et ad pugnandum robustissimi numerus autem eorum viginti duo milia et triginta quattuor
clem: Filii Bela: Esbon, et Ozi, et Oziel, et Jerimoth, et Urai, quinque principes familiarum, et ad pugnandum robustissimi: numerus autem eorum, viginti duo millia et triginta quatuor.
kjv: And the sons of Bela; Ezbon, and Uzzi, and Uzziel, and Jerimoth, and Iri, five; heads of the house of their fathers, mighty men of valour; and were reckoned by their genealogies twenty and two thousand and thirty and four.

wlc: וּבְנֵי בֶכֶר זְמִירָה וְיוֹעָשׁ וֶאֱלִיעֶזֶר וְאֶלְיוֹעֵינַי וְעָמְרִי וִירֵמוֹת וַאֲבִיָּה וַעֲנָתוֹת וְעָלָמֶת כָּל־אֵלֶּה בְּנֵי־בָכֶר ׃
lxx: καὶ υἱοὶ Ἀβαχεί Ἀμαρίας καὶ Ἰωὰς καὶ Ἐλιέζερ καὶ Ἐλειθαινὰν καὶ Ἀμαρειὰ καὶ Αὐρημὼθ καὶ Ἀβιοὺδ καὶ Ἀναθὼθ καὶ Γεμέεθ. πάντες οὗτοι υἱοὶ Ἀμαχείρ,
vulg: porro filii Bochor Zamira et Ioas et Eliezer et Helioenai et Amri et Ierimoth et Abia et Anathoth et Almathan omnes hii filii Bochor
clem: Porro filii Bechor: Zamira, et Joas, et Eliezer, et Elionai, et Amri, et Jerimoth, et Abia, et Anathoth, et Almath: omnes hi filii Bechor.
kjv: And the sons of Becher; Zemira, and Joash, and Eliezer, and Elioenai, and Omri, and Jerimoth, and Abiah, and Anathoth, and Alameth. All these are the sons of Becher.

wlc: וְהִתְיַחְשָׂם לְתֹלְדוֹתָם רָאשֵׁי בֵּית אֲבוֹתָם גִּבּוֹרֵי חָיִל עֶשְׂרִים אֶלֶף וּמָאתָיִם ׃ ס
lxx: καὶ ὁ ἀριθμὸς αὐτῶν κατὰ γενέσεις αὐτῶν, ἄρχοντες οἴκων πατριῶν αὐτῶν ἰσχυροὶ δυνάμει, εἵκοσι χιλιάδες καὶ διακόσιοι.
vulg: numerati sunt autem per familias suas principes cognationum ad bella fortissimi viginti milia et ducenti
clem: Numerati sunt autem per familias suas principes cognationum suarum ad bella fortissimi, viginti millia et ducenti.
kjv: And the number of them, after their genealogy by their generations, heads of the house of their fathers, mighty men of valour, was twenty thousand and two hundred.

wlc: וּבְנֵי יְדִיעֲאֵל בִּלְהָן וּבְנֵי בִלְהָן יְעִישׁ וּבִנְיָמִן וְאֵהוּד וּכְנַעֲנָה וְזֵיתָן וְתַרְשִׁישׁ וַאֲחִישָׁחַר ׃
lxx: καὶ υἱοὶ Ἀριήλ· Βαλαάν. καὶ υἱοὶ Βαλαάν· Ἰαοὺς καὶ Βενιαμεὶν καὶ Ἀὼθ καὶ Χανάαν καὶ Ζαιθὰν καὶ Ῥαμεσσαὶ καὶ Ἀχεισάδαρ.
vulg: porro filii Iadihel Balan filii autem Balan Hieus et Beniamin et Ahoth et Chanana et Iothan et Tharsis et Haisaar
clem: Porro filii Jadihel: Balan. Filii autem Balan: Jehus, et Benjamin, et Aod, et Chanana, et Zethan, et Tharsis, et Ahisahar:
kjv: The sons also of Jediael; Bilhan: and the sons of Bilhan; Jeush, and Benjamin, and Ehud, and Chenaanah, and Zethan, and Tharshish, and Ahishahar.

wlc: כָּל־אֵלֶּה בְּנֵי יְדִיעֲאֵל לְרָאשֵׁי הָאָבוֹת גִּבּוֹרֵי חֲיָלִים שִׁבְעָה־עָשָׂר אֶלֶף וּמָאתַיִם יֹצְאֵי צָבָא לַמִּלְחָמָה ׃
lxx: πάντες οὗτοι υἱοὶ Ἀριήκ, ἄρχοντες τῶν πατριῶν ἰσχυροὶ δυνάμει, ἑπτὰ καὶ δέκα χιλιάδες καὶ διακόσιοι, ἐκπορευόμενοι δυνάμει τοῦ πολεμεῖν·
vulg: omnes hii filii Iadihel principes cognationum suarum viri fortissimi decem et septem milia et ducenti ad proelium procedentes
clem: omnes hi filii Jadihel, principes cognationum suarum viri fortissimi, decem et septem millia et ducenti ad prlium procedentes.
kjv: All these the sons of Jediael, by the heads of their fathers, mighty men of valour, were seventeen thousand and two hundred soldiers, fit to go out for war and battle.

wlc: וְשֻׁפִּם וְחֻפִּם בְּנֵי עִיר חֻשִׁם בְּנֵי אַחֵר ׃
lxx: καὶ Σαπφεὶν καὶ Ἀπφείν, καὶ υἱοὶ Ῥαώμ, υἱὸς αὐτοῦ Ἀἐρ.
vulg: Sephan quoque et Apham filii Hir et Asim filii Aer
clem: Sepham quoque et Hapham filii Hir: et Hasim filii Aher.
kjv: Shuppim also, and Huppim, the children of Ir, and Hushim, the sons of Aher.

wlc: בְּנֵי נַפְתָּלִי יַחֲצִיאֵל וְגוּנִי וְיֵצֶר וְשַׁלּוּם בְּנֵי בִלְהָה ׃ פ
lxx: Υἱοὶ Nεφθαλεί Ἰεισιήλ, Γωνεὶ καὶ Ἰσσειὴρ καὶ Σαλωμών, υἱοὶ Βαλάμ.
vulg: filii autem Nepthali Iasihel et Guni et Asar et Sellum filii Balaa
clem: Filii autem Nephthali: Jaziel, et Guni, et Jeser, et Sellum, filii Bala.
kjv: The sons of Naphtali; Jahziel, and Guni, and Jezer, and Shallum, the sons of Bilhah.

wlc: בְּנֵי מְנַשֶּׁה אַשְׂרִיאֵל אֲשֶׁר יָלָדָה פִּילַגְשׁוֹ הָאֲרַמִּיָּה יָלְדָה אֶת־מָכִיר אֲבִי גִלְעָד ׃
lxx: Υἱοὶ Μανασσή· Ἀσερειήλ, ὃν ἔτεκεν ἡ παλλακὴ αὐτοῦ ἡ Σύρα· ἔτεκεν τὸν Μαχεὶρ πατέρα Γαλαὰδ.
vulg: porro filius Manasse Esrihel concubinaque eius syra peperit Machir patrem Galaad
clem: Porro filius Manasse, Esriel: concubinaque ejus Syra peperit Machir patrem Galaad.
kjv: The sons of Manasseh; Ashriel, whom she bare: (but his concubine the Aramitess bare Machir the father of Gilead:

wlc: וּמָכִיר לָקַח אִשָּׁה לְחֻפִּים וּלְשֻׁפִּים וְשֵׁם אֲחֹתוֹ מַעֲכָה וְשֵׁם הַשֵּׁנִי צְלָפְחָד וַתִּהְיֶנָה לִצְלָפְחָד בָּנוֹת ׃
lxx: καὶ Μαχεὶρ ἔλαβεν γυναῖκα τῷ Ἀμφεὶν καὶ Μαμφείν· καὶ ὄνομα ἀδελφῆς αὐτοῦ Μοωχά, καὶ ὄνομα τῇ δευτέρᾳ Σαπφαάδ.
vulg: Machir autem accepit uxores filiis suis Happhim et Sepham et habuit sororem nomine Maacha nomen autem secundi Salphaad nataeque sunt Salphaad filiae
clem: Machir autem accepit uxores filiis suis Happhim, et Saphan: et habuit sororem nomine Maacha: nomen autem secundi, Salphaad, natque sunt Salphaad fili.
kjv: And Machir took to wife the sister of Huppim and Shuppim, whose sister's name was Maachah;) and the name of the second was Zelophehad: and Zelophehad had daughters.

wlc: וַתֵּלֶד מַעֲכָה אֵשֶׁת־מָכִיר בֵּן וַתִּקְרָא שְׁמוֹ פֶּרֶשׁ וְשֵׁם אָחִיו שָׁרֶשׁ וּבָנָיו אוּלָם וָרָקֶם ׃
lxx: καὶ ἔτεκεν Μοωχὰ γυνὴ Μαχεὶρ υἱόν, καὶ ἐκάλεσεν τὸ ὄνομα αὐτοῦ Σοῦρος· υἱὸς αὐτοῦ Οὐλάμ,
vulg: et peperit Maacha uxor Machir filium vocavitque nomen eius Phares porro nomen fratris eius Sares et filii eius Ulam et Recem
clem: Et peperit Maacha uxor Machir filium, vocavitque nomen ejus Phares: porro nomen fratris ejus, Sares: et filii ejus, Ulam, et Recen.
kjv: And Maachah the wife of Machir bare a son, and she called his name Peresh; and the name of his brother was Sheresh; and his sons were Ulam and Rakem.

wlc: וּבְנֵי אוּלָם בְּדָן אֵלֶּה בְּנֵי גִלְעָד בֶּן־מָכִיר בֶּן־מְנַשֶּׁה ׃
lxx: Βαδάμ. οὅτοι υἱοὶ Γαλαὰδ υἱοῦ Μαχεὶρ υἱοῦ Μανασσή.
vulg: filius autem Ulam Badan hii sunt filii Galaad filii Machir filii Manasse
clem: Filius autem Ulam, Badan: hi sunt filii Galaad, filii Machir, filii Manasse.
kjv: And the sons of Ulam; Bedan. These were the sons of Gilead, the son of Machir, the son of Manasseh.

wlc: וַאֲחֹתוֹ הַמֹּלֶכֶת יָלְדָה אֶת־אִישְׁהוֹד וְאֶת־אֲבִיעֶזֶר וְאֶת־מַחְלָה ׃
lxx: καὶ ἀδελφὴ αὐτοῦ ἡ Μαλέχεθ ἔτεκεν τὸν Ἰσαδὲκ καὶ τὸν Ἀβιέζερ καὶ τὸν Μαελά.
vulg: soror autem eius Regina peperit virum Decorum et Abiezer et Moola
clem: Soror autem ejus Regina peperit Virum decorum, et Abiezer, et Mohola.
kjv: And his sister Hammoleketh bare Ishod, and Abiezer, and Mahalah.

wlc: וַיִּהְיוּ בְּנֵי שְׁמִידָע אַחְיָן וָשֶׁכֶם וְלִקְחִי וַאֲנִיעָם ׃ פ
lxx: καὶ ἤσαν υἱοὶ Σεμειρά· Ἰααὶμ καὶ Σύχεμ καὶ λακεεὶμ καὶ Ἀλιαλείμ.
vulg: erant autem filii Semida Ahin et Sechem et Leci et Aniam
clem: Erant autem filii Semida, Ahin, et Sechem, et Leci, et Aniam.
kjv: And the sons of Shemidah were, Ahian, and Shechem, and Likhi, and Aniam.

wlc: וּבְנֵי אֶפְרַיִם שׁוּתָלַח וּבֶרֶד בְּנוֹ וְתַחַת בְּנוֹ וְאֶלְעָדָה בְנוֹ וְתַחַת בְּנוֹ ׃
lxx: Καὶ υἱοὶ Ἐφράιμ· Σωθάλαθ. υἱοὶ Λααδά· υἱὸς αὐτοῦ Νοομέ,
vulg: filii autem Ephraim Suthala Bareth filius eius Thaath filius eius Elada filius eius Thaath filius eius et huius filius Zabad
clem: Filii autem Ephraim: Suthala, Bared filius ejus, Thahath filius ejus, Elada filius ejus, Thahath filius ejus, hujus filius Zabad,
kjv: And the sons of Ephraim; Shuthelah, and Bered his son, and Tahath his son, and Eladah his son, and Tahath his son,

wlc: וְזָבָד בְּנוֹ וְשׁוּתֶלַח בְּנוֹ וְעֵזֶר וְאֶלְעָד וַהֲרָגוּם אַנְשֵׁי־גַת הַנּוֹלָדִים בָּאָרֶץ כִּי יָרְדוּ לָקַחַת אֶת־מִקְנֵיהֶם ׃
lxx: υἱὸς αὐτοῦ Σάβεδ, υἱοὶ αὐτοῦ Ὄζαρ καὶ Ἐλαάδ· καὶ ἀπέκτειναν αὐτὸν ἄνδρες Τὲθ οἱ τεχθέντες ἐν γῇ, ὅτι κατέβησαν τοῦ λαβεῖν τὰ κτήνη αὐτῶν.
vulg: et huius filius Suthala et huius filius Ezer et Elad occiderunt autem eos viri Geth indigenae quia descenderant ut invaderent possessiones eorum
clem: et hujus filius Suthula, et hujus filius Ezer et Elad: occiderunt autem eos viri Geth indigen, quia descenderant ut invaderent possessiones eorum.
kjv: And Zabad his son, and Shuthelah his son, and Ezer, and Elead, whom the men of Gath that were born in that land slew, because they came down to take away their cattle.

wlc: וַיִּתְאַבֵּל אֶפְרַיִם אֲבִיהֶם יָמִים רַבִּים וַיָּבֹאוּ אֶחָיו לְנַחֲמוֹ ׃
lxx: καὶ ἐπένθησεν Ἐφράιμ πατὴρ αὐτῶν ἡμέρας πολλάς, καὶ ἦλθον ἀδελφοὶ αὐτῶν τοῦ παρακαλέσαι αὐτόν,
vulg: luxit igitur Ephraim pater eorum multis diebus et venerunt fratres eius ut consolarentur eum
clem: Luxit igitur Ephraim pater eorum multis diebus, et venerunt fratres ejus ut consolarentur eum.
kjv: And Ephraim their father mourned many days, and his brethren came to comfort him.

wlc: וַיָּבֹא אֶל־אִשְׁתּוֹ וַתַּהַר וַתֵּלֶד בֵּן וַיִּקְרָא אֶת־שְׁמוֹ בְּרִיעָה כִּי בְרָעָה הָיְתָה בְּבֵיתוֹ ׃
lxx: καὶ εἰσῆλθεν πρὸς τὴν γυναῖκα αὐτοῦ, καὶ ἔλαβεν ἐν γαστρὶ καὶ ἔτεκεν υἱόν, καὶ ἐκάλεσεν τὸ ὄνομα αὐτοῦ Βαργαά, ὅτι Ἐν κακοῖς ἐγένετο ἐν οἴκῳ μου
vulg: ingressusque est ad uxorem suam quae concepit et peperit filium et vocavit nomen eius Beria eo quod in malis domus eius ortus esset
clem: Ingressusque est ad uxorem suam: qu concepit, et peperit filium, et vocavit nomen ejus Beria, eo quod in malis domus ejus ortus esset:
kjv: And when he went in to his wife, she conceived, and bare a son, and he called his name Beriah, because it went evil with his house.

wlc: וּבִתּוֹ שֶׁאֱרָה וַתִּבֶן אֶת־בֵּית־חוֹרוֹן הַתַּחְתּוֹן וְאֶת־הָעֶלְיוֹן וְאֵת אֻזֵּן שֶׁאֱרָה ׃
lxx: καὶ ἐν ἐκείνοις τοῖς καταλοίποις· καὶ ᾠκοδόμησεν Βαιθωρὼν τὴν κάτω καὶ τὴν ἄνω. καὶ υἱοὶ Οζάν· Σεηρὰ
vulg: filia autem eius fuit Sara quae aedificavit Bethoron inferiorem et superiorem et Ozensara
clem: filia autem ejus fuit Sara, qu dificavit Bethoron inferiorem et superiorem, et Ozensara.
kjv: (And his daughter was Sherah, who built Bethhoron the nether, and the upper, and Uzzensherah.)

wlc: וְרֶפַח בְּנוֹ וְרֶשֶׁף וְתֶלַח בְּנוֹ וְתַחַן בְּנוֹ ׃
lxx: καὶ Ῥάφη υἱρὶ αὐτοῦ, Σάραφ καὶ Θάλεες υἱοὶ αὐτοῦ, θάεν υἱὸς αὐτοῦ.
vulg: porro filius eius Rapha et Reseph et Thale de quo natus est Thaan
clem: Porro filius ejus Rapha, et Reseph, et Thale, de quo natus est Thaan,
kjv: And Rephah was his son, also Resheph, and Telah his son, and Tahan his son.

wlc: לַעְדָּן בְּנוֹ עַמִּיהוּד בְּנוֹ אֱלִישָׁמָע בְּנוֹ ׃
lxx: τῷ ΛΑδδὰν υἱῷ αὐτοῦ υἱρὶ Ἀμιουείδ, υἱρὶ Ἐλειμασαί,
vulg: qui genuit Laadan huius quoque filius Ammiud genuit Elisama
clem: qui genuit Laadan: hujus quoque filius Ammiud, qui genuit Elisama,
kjv: Laadan his son, Ammihud his son, Elishama his son.

wlc: נוֹן בְּנוֹ יְהוֹשֻׁעַ בְּנוֹ ׃
lxx: υἱοὶ Νούμ, υἱρὶ Ἰησοῦε, υἱοὶ αὐτοῦ.
vulg: de quo ortus est Nun qui habuit filium Iosue
clem: de quo ortus est Nun, qui habuit filium Josue.
kjv: Non his son, Jehoshuah his son.

wlc: וַאֲחֻזָּתָם וּמֹשְׁבוֹתָם בֵּית־אֵל וּבְנֹתֶיהָ וְלַמִּזְרָח נַעֲרָן וְלַמַּעֲרָב גֶּזֶר וּבְנֹתֶיהָ וּשְׁכֶם וּבְנֹתֶיהָ עַד־עַיָּה וּבְנֹתֶיהָ ׃
lxx: καὶ κατάσχεσις αὐτῶν καὶ κατοικία αὐτῶν· Βαιθὴλ καὶ αἱ κῶμαι αὐτῆς, κατʼ ἀνατολὰς Νααρνάν, πρὸς δυσμαῖς Γάζερ καὶ αἱ κῶμαι αὐτῆς, καὶ Συχἰμ καὶ αἱ κῶμαι αὐτῆς ἕως Γαιὰν καὶ αἱ κῶμαι αὐτῆς·
vulg: possessio autem eorum et habitatio Bethel cum filiabus suis et contra orientem Noran ad occidentalem plagam Gazer et filiae eius Sychem quoque cum filiabus suis usque Aza et filias eius
clem: Possessio autem eorum et habitatio, Bethel cum filiabus suis, et contra orientem Noran, ad occidentalem plagam Gazer et fili ejus, Sichem quoque cum filiabus suis, usque ad Aza cum filiabus ejus.
kjv: And their possessions and habitations were, Bethel and the towns thereof, and eastward Naaran, and westward Gezer, with the towns thereof; Shechem also and the towns thereof, unto Gaza and the towns thereof:

wlc: וְעַל־יְדֵי בְנֵי־מְנַשֶּׁה בֵּית־שְׁאָן וּבְנֹתֶיהָ תַּעְנַךְ וּבְנֹתֶיהָ מְגִדּוֹ וּבְנוֹתֶיהָ דּוֹר וּבְנוֹתֶיהָ בְּאֵלֶּה יָשְׁבוּ בְּנֵי יוֹסֵף בֶּן־יִשְׂרָאֵל ׃ פ
lxx: καὶ ἕως ὁρίων υἱῶν Μανασσή, Βαιθσαὰν καὶ αἱ κῶμαι αὐτῆς, Θαλμὴ καὶ αἱ κῶμαι αὐτῆς· καὶ Βαλὰδ καὶ αἱ κῶμαι αὐτῆς, Μαγεδδεὶ καὶ αἱ κῶμαι αὐτῆς, Δὼρ καὶ αἱ κῶμαι αὐτῆς· ἐν ταύτῃ κατῷκησαν οἱ υἱοὶ Ἰωσὴφ υἱοῦ Ἰσραήλ.
vulg: iuxta filios quoque Manasse Bethsan et filias eius Thanach et filias eius Mageddo et filias eius Dor et filias eius in his habitaverunt filii Ioseph filii Israhel
clem: Juxta filios quoque Manasse, Bethsan et filias ejus, Thanach et filias ejus, Mageddo et filias ejus, Dor et filias ejus: in his habitaverunt filii Joseph, filii Isral.
kjv: And by the borders of the children of Manasseh, Bethshean and her towns, Taanach and her towns, Megiddo and her towns, Dor and her towns. In these dwelt the children of Joseph the son of Israel.

wlc: בְּנֵי אָשֵׁר יִמְנָה וְיִשְׁוָה וְיִשְׁוִי וּבְרִיעָה וְשֶׂרַח אֲחוֹתָם ׃
lxx: Υἱοὶ Ἀσήρ· Ἰνινὰ καὶ Ἰσουὰ καὶ Ἰσουὶ καὶ Βεριγὰ καὶ Σορέ, καὶ ἀδελφὴ αὐτῶν.
vulg: filii Aser Iomna et Iesua et Isui et Baria et Sara soror eorum
clem: Filii Aser: Jemna, et Jesua, et Jessui, et Baria, et Sara soror eorum.
kjv: The sons of Asher; Imnah, and Isuah, and Ishuai, and Beriah, and Serah their sister.

wlc: וּבְנֵי בְרִיעָה חֶבֶר וּמַלְכִּיאֵל הוּא אֲבִי בִרְזוֹת ׃
lxx: υἱοὶ Βεριχά· Γάβερ καὶ Μελλειή, οὗτος πατὴρ Βηζαίθ.
vulg: filii autem Baria Heber et Melchihel ipse est pater Barzaith
clem: Filii autem Baria: Heber, et Melchiel: ipse est pater Barsaith.
kjv: And the sons of Beriah; Heber, and Malchiel, who is the father of Birzavith.

wlc: וְחֶבֶר הוֹלִיד אֶת־יַפְלֵט וְאֶת־שׁוֹמֵר וְאֶת־חוֹתָם וְאֵת שׁוּעָא אֲחוֹתָם ׃
lxx: καὶ Χάβερ ἐγέννησεν τὸν Ἰφαμὴλ καὶ τὸν Σαμὴρ καὶ τὸν Χωθὰν καὶ τὴν Σωλὰ ἀδελφὴν αὐτῶν.
vulg: Heber autem genuit Iephlat et Somer et Otham et Suaa sororem eorum
clem: Heber autem genuit Jephlat, et Somer, et Hotham, et Suaa sororem eorum.
kjv: And Heber begat Japhlet, and Shomer, and Hotham, and Shua their sister.

wlc: וּבְנֵי יַפְלֵט פָּסַךְ וּבִמְהָל וְעַשְׁוָת אֵלֶּה בְּנֵי יַפְלֵט ׃
lxx: καὶ υἱοὶ Ἀφαλήχ· Βαισηχί. μαβαὴλ καὶ ᾈσεῖΘ· οὗτοι υἱοὶ Ἰαφαλήλ.
vulg: filii Iephlat Phosech et Chamaal et Asoth hii filii Iephlat
clem: Filii Jephlat: Phosech, et Chamaal, et Asoth: hi filii Jephlat.
kjv: And the sons of Japhlet; Pasach, and Bimhal, and Ashvath. These are the children of Japhlet.

wlc: וּבְנֵי שָׁמֶר אֲחִי וְרָוהְגָּה יְחֻבָּה וַאֲרָם ׃
lxx: καὶ υἱοὶ Σἐμμηρ· Ἀχιουιὰ καὶ Ὠβάβ, Ἀκαρὰν
vulg: porro filii Somer Ahi et Roaga et Iaba et Aram
clem: Porro filii Somer: Ahi, et Roaga, et Haba, et Aram.
kjv: And the sons of Shamer; Ahi, and Rohgah, Jehubbah, and Aram.

wlc: וּבֶן־הֵלֶם אָחִיו צוֹפַח וְיִמְנָע וְשֵׁלֶשׁ וְעָמָל ׃
lxx: καὶ Βαλαάμ· ἀδελφοὶ αὐτοῦ Σωχὰθ καὶ Ἰμανὰ καὶ Ζέμη καὶ Ἀμαά.
vulg: filii autem Helem fratris eius Supha et Iemna et Selles et Amal
clem: Filii autem Helem fratris ejus: Supha, et Jemna, et Selles, et Amal.
kjv: And the sons of his brother Helem; Zophah, and Imna, and Shelesh, and Amal.

wlc: בְּנֵי צוֹפָח סוּחַ וְחַרְנֶפֶר וְשׁוּעָל וּבֵרִי וְיִמְרָה ׃
lxx: υἱοὶ Σωφάς· Χουχί, Ἁναρφὰρ καὶ Σουλὰ καὶ Σαβρεὶ καὶ Ἰμαρή,
vulg: filii Supha Sue Arnaphed et Sual et Beri et Iamra
clem: Filii Supha: Sue, Harnapher, et Sual, et Beri, et Jamra,
kjv: The sons of Zophah; Suah, and Harnepher, and Shual, and Beri, and Imrah,

wlc: בֶּצֶר וָהוֹד וְשַׁמָּא וְשִׁלְשָׁה וְיִתְרָן וּבְאֵרָא ׃
lxx: Σόβαλ καὶ Ὣδ καὶ Σεμὰ καὶ Σαλεισὰ καὶ Θερὰ καὶ Βαιαιλά.
vulg: Bosor et Od et Samma et Salusa et Iethran et Bera
clem: Bosor, et Hod, et Samma, et Salusa, et Jethran, et Bera.
kjv: Bezer, and Hod, and Shamma, and Shilshah, and Ithran, and Beera.

wlc: וּבְנֵי יֶתֶר יְפֻנֶּה וּפִסְפָּה וַאְרָא ׃
lxx: καὶ υἱοὶ Ἰέθηρ· Ἰφινὰ καὶ Φασφαὶ καὶ Ἀρά·
vulg: filii Iether Iephonne et Phaspha et Ara
clem: Filii Jether: Jephone, et Phaspha, et Ara.
kjv: And the sons of Jether; Jephunneh, and Pispah, and Ara.

wlc: וּבְנֵי עֻלָּא אָרַח וְחַנִּיאֵל וְרִצְיָא ׃
lxx: καὶ υἱοὶ Ὠλά· Ὀρέχ, Ἀνειὴλ καὶ Ῥασειά.
vulg: filii autem Olla Aree et Anihel et Resia
clem: Filii autem Olla: Aree, et Haniel, et Resia.
kjv: And the sons of Ulla; Arah, and Haniel, and Rezia.

wlc: כָּל־אֵלֶּה בְנֵי־אָשֵׁר רָאשֵׁי בֵית־הָאָבוֹת בְּרוּרִים גִּבּוֹרֵי חֲיָלִים רָאשֵׁי הַנְּשִׂיאִים וְהִתְיַחְשָׂם בַּצָּבָא בַּמִּלְחָמָה מִסְפָּרָם אֲנָשִׁים עֶשְׂרִים וְשִׁשָּׁה אָלֶף ׃ ס
lxx: πάντες οὖτοι υἱοὶ Ἀσήρ, πάντες ἄρχοντες πατριῶν ἐκλεκτοὶ ἰσχυροὶ δυνάμει, ἄρχοντες ἡγούμενοι ἀριθμὸς αὐτῶν εἰς παράταξιν τοῦ πολεμεῖν, ἀριθμὸς αὐτῶν ἄνδρες εἴκοσι ἓξ χιλιάδες.
vulg: omnes hii filii Aser principes cognationum electi atque fortissimi duces ducum numerus autem eorum aetatis quae apta esset ad bellum viginti sex milia
clem: Omnes hi filii Aser, principes cognationum, electi atque fortissimi duces ducum: numerus autem eorum tatis qu apta esset ad bellum, viginti sex millia.
kjv: All these were the children of Asher, heads of their father's house, choice and mighty men of valour, chief of the princes. And the number throughout the genealogy of them that were apt to the war and to battle was twenty and six thousand men.

wlc: וּבִנְיָמִן הוֹלִיד אֶת־בֶּלַע בְּכֹרוֹ אַשְׁבֵּל הַשֵּׁנִי וְאַחְרַח הַשְּׁלִישִׁי ׃
lxx: Καὶ Βενιαμεὶν ἐγέννησεν Βελελεὴλ πρωτότοκον αὐτοῦ καὶ Σαβὰ τὸν δεύτερον, Ἰαφαὴλ τὸν τρίτον,
vulg: Beniamin autem genuit Bale primogenitum suum Asbal secundum Ohora tertium
clem: Benjamin autem genuit Bale primogenitum suum, Asbel secundum, Ahara tertium,
kjv: Now Benjamin begat Bela his firstborn, Ashbel the second, and Aharah the third,

wlc: נוֹחָה הָרְבִיעִי וְרָפָא הַחֲמִישִׁי ׃ ס
lxx: Ἰωὰ τὸν τέταρτον, καὶ Ῥαφὴ τὸν πέμπτον.
vulg: Nuaha quartum et Rapha quintum
clem: Nohaa quartum, et Rapha quintum.
kjv: Nohah the fourth, and Rapha the fifth.

wlc: וַיִּהְיוּ בָנִים לְבָלַע אַדָּר וְגֵרָא וַאֲבִיהוּד ׃
lxx: καὶ ἦσαν υἱρὶ τῷ Βάλε· Ἄλει καὶ Γηρὰ καὶ Ἀβιοὺδ
vulg: fueruntque filii Bale Addaor et Gera et Abiud
clem: Fueruntque filii Bale: Addar, et Gera, et Abiud,
kjv: And the sons of Bela were, Addar, and Gera, and Abihud,

wlc: וַאֲבִישׁוּעַ וְנַעֲמָן וַאֲחוֹחַ ׃
lxx: καὶ Ἀβεισάμας καὶ Νοομὰ καὶ Ἀχιὰ
vulg: Abisue quoque et Neman et Ahoe
clem: Abisue quoque et Naaman, et Aho,
kjv: And Abishua, and Naaman, and Ahoah,

wlc: וְגֵרָא וּשְׁפוּפָן וְחוּרָם ׃
lxx: καὶ Γερὰ καὶ Σωφαρφὰκ καὶ Ὡἰμ.
vulg: sed et Gera et Sephuphan et Uram
clem: sed et Gera, et Sephuphan, et Huram.
kjv: And Gera, and Shephuphan, and Huram.

wlc: וְאֵלֶּה בְּנֵי אֵחוּד אֵלֶּה הֵם רָאשֵׁי אָבוֹת לְיוֹשְׁבֵי גֶבַע וַיַּגְלוּם אֶל־מָנָחַת ׃
lxx: οὗτοιυἱοὶ Ἀώδ· οὗτοί εἰσιν ἄρχοντες πατριῶν τοῖς κατοικοῦσιν Γάβερ, καὶ μετῴκισαν αὐτοὺς εἰς Μαχαναθεί
vulg: hii sunt filii Aod principes cognationum habitantium in Gabaa qui translati sunt in Manath
clem: Hi sunt filii Ahod, principes cognationum habitantium in Gabaa, qui translati sunt in Manahath.
kjv: And these are the sons of Ehud: these are the heads of the fathers of the inhabitants of Geba, and they removed them to Manahath:

wlc: וְנַעֲמָן וַאֲחִיָּה וְגֵרָא הוּא הֶגְלָם וְהוֹלִיד אֶת־עֻזָּא וְאֶת־אֲחִיחֻד ׃
lxx: καὶ Νοομὰ καὶ Ἀχειὰ καὶ Γηρά· οὗτος Ἰγαάμ, ἐγέννησεν τὸν Ναανὰ καὶ τὸν Ἰαχειχώλ.
vulg: Nooman autem et Achia et Gera ipse transtulit eos et genuit Oza et Ahiud
clem: Naaman autem, et Achia, et Gera, ipse transtulit eos, et genuit Osa, et Ahiud.
kjv: And Naaman, and Ahiah, and Gera, he removed them, and begat Uzza, and Ahihud.

wlc: וְשַׁחֲרַיִם הוֹלִיד בִּשְׂדֵה מוֹאָב מִן־שִׁלְחוֹ אֹתָם חוּשִׁים וְאֶת־בַּעֲרָא נָשָׁיו ׃
lxx: καὶ Σααρὴλ ἐγέννησεν ἐν τῷ πεδίῳ Μωὰβ μετὰ τὸ ἀποστεῖλαι αὐτὸν Σωσὶν καὶ τὴν Ἰβααδὰ γυναῖκα αὐτοῦ.
vulg: porro Saarim genuit in regione Moab postquam dimisit Usim et Bara uxores suas
clem: Porro Saharaim genuit in regione Moab, postquam dimisit Husim et Bara uxores suas.
kjv: And Shaharaim begat children in the country of Moab, after he had sent them away; Hushim and Baara were his wives.

wlc: וַיּוֹלֶד מִן־חֹדֶשׁ אִשְׁתּוֹ אֶת־יוֹבָב וְאֶת־צִבְיָא וְאֶת־מֵישָׁא וְאֶת־מַלְכָּם ׃
lxx: καὶ ἐγέννησεν ἐκ τῆς Ἅδα γυναικὸς αὐτοῦ τὸν Ἰωβὰβ καὶ τὸν Ἰεβιὰ καὶ τὸν Μισὰ καὶ τὸν Μελχὰς
vulg: genuit autem de Edes uxore sua Iobab et Sebia et Mosa et Molchom
clem: Genuit autem de Hodes uxore sua Jobab, et Sebia, et Mosa, et Molchom,
kjv: And he begat of Hodesh his wife, Jobab, and Zibia, and Mesha, and Malcham,

wlc: וְאֶת־יְעוּץ וְאֶת־שָׂכְיָה וְאֶת־מִרְמָה אֵלֶּה בָנָיו רָאשֵׁי אָבוֹת ׃
lxx: καὶ τὸν Ἰδὼς καὶ τὸν Σαβιὰ καὶ τὸν Ἰμαμά· οὗτοι ἄρχοντες πατριῶν.
vulg: Iehus quoque et Sechia et Marma hii sunt filii eius principes in familiis suis
clem: Jehus quoque, et Sechia, et Marma: hi sunt filii ejus principes in familiis suis.
kjv: And Jeuz, and Shachia, and Mirma. These were his sons, heads of the fathers.

wlc: וּמֵחֻשִׁים הוֹלִיד אֶת־אֲבִיטוּב וְאֶת־אֶלְפָּעַל ׃
lxx: καὶ ἐκ τῆς Ὡσιμὲν ἐγέννησεν τὸν Ἀβιτὰβ καὶ τὸν Ἀλφάαδ.
vulg: Meusim vero genuit Abitob et Elphaal
clem: Mehusim vero genuit Abitob et Elphaal.
kjv: And of Hushim he begat Abitub, and Elpaal.

wlc: וּבְנֵי אֶלְפַּעַל עֵבֶר וּמִשְׁעָם וָשָׁמֶד הוּא בָּנָה אֶת־אוֹנוֹ וְאֶת־לֹד וּבְנֹתֶיהָ ׃
lxx: καὶ υἱοὶ Ἀλφάαδ· Ὠβήδ, Μεσσαάμ, Σήμηρ· οὗτος ᾠκοδόμησεν τὴν Ὠνὰν καὶ τὰς κώμας αὐτῆς·
vulg: porro filii Elphaal Heber et Misaam et Samad hic aedificavit Ono et Lod et filias eius
clem: Porro filii Elphaal: Heber, et Misaam, et Samad: hic dificavit Ono, et Lod, et filias ejus.
kjv: The sons of Elpaal; Eber, and Misham, and Shamed, who built Ono, and Lod, with the towns thereof:

wlc: וּבְרִעָה וָשֶׁמַע הֵמָּה רָאשֵׁי הָאָבוֹת לְיוֹשְׁבֵי אַיָּלוֹן הֵמָּה הִבְרִיחוּ אֶת־יוֹשְׁבֵי גַת ׃
lxx: καὶ Βεριγὰ καὶ Σάμα· οὗτοι ἄρχοντες τῶν πατριῶν τοῖς κατοικοῦσιν Αἰλάμ, καὶ οὗτοι ἐξεδίωξαν τοὺς καιοικοῦντας Γεθ.
vulg: Bara autem et Samma principes cognationum habitantium in Aialon hii fugaverunt habitatores Geth
clem: Baria autem et Sama principes cognationum habitantium in Ajalon: hi fugaverunt habitatores Geth.
kjv: Beriah also, and Shema, who were heads of the fathers of the inhabitants of Aijalon, who drove away the inhabitants of Gath:

wlc: וְאַחְיוֹ שָׁשָׁק וִירֵמוֹת ׃
lxx: καὶ ἀδελφὸς αὐτοῦ Σωκὴλ καὶ Ἰαρειμὼθ
vulg: et Haio et Sesac et Ierimoth
clem: Et Ahio, et Sesac, et Jerimoth,
kjv: And Ahio, Shashak, and Jeremoth,

wlc: וּזְבַדְיָה וַעֲרָד וָעָדֶר ׃
lxx: καὶ Ἀζαβαβιὰ καὶ Ὠρὴρ καὶ Ὤβηδ
vulg: et Zabadia et Arod et Eder
clem: et Zabadia, et Arod, et Heder,
kjv: And Zebadiah, and Arad, and Ader,

wlc: וּמִיכָאֵל וְיִשְׁפָּה וְיוֹחָא בְּנֵי בְרִיעָה ׃
lxx: καὶ Μειχαὴλ καὶ Σοφὰν καὶ Ἰωαχάν, υἱοὶ Βαρειγά·
vulg: Michahel quoque et Iespha et Ioaa filii Baria
clem: Michal quoque, et Jespha, et Joha filii Baria.
kjv: And Michael, and Ispah, and Joha, the sons of Beriah;

wlc: וּזְבַדְיָה וּמְשֻׁלָּם וְחִזְקִי וָחָבֶר ׃
lxx: καὶ Σαβαδιὰ καὶ Μοσολλὰμ καὶ Ἀζακεὶ καὶ Ἀβαρ
vulg: et Zabadia et Mosollam et Ezeci et Heber
clem: Et Zabadia, et Mosollam, et Hezeci, et Heber,
kjv: And Zebadiah, and Meshullam, and Hezeki, and Heber,

wlc: וְיִשְׁמְרַי וְיִזְלִיאָה וְיוֹבָב בְּנֵי אֶלְפָּעַל ׃
lxx: καὶ Σαμαρεὶ καὶ Σαρειὰ καὶ Ἰωάβ, υἱοὶ Ἐλχάαδ·
vulg: et Iesamari et Iezlia et Iobab filii Elphaal
clem: et Jesamari, et Jezlia, et Jobab filii Elphaal,
kjv: Ishmerai also, and Jezliah, and Jobab, the sons of Elpaal;

wlc: וְיָקִים וְזִכְרִי וְזַבְדִּי ׃
lxx: καὶ Ἰακεὶμ καὶ Ζαχρεὶ καὶ Σαβδεὶ
vulg: et Iacim et Zechri et Zabdi
clem: et Jacim, et Zechri, et Zabdi,
kjv: And Jakim, and Zichri, and Zabdi,

wlc: וֶאֱלִיעֵנַי וְצִלְּתַי וֶאֱלִיאֵל ׃
lxx: καὶ Ἐλιωλιαὰ καὶ Σαλθεὶ καὶ Ἐλιηλεὶ
vulg: et Helioenai et Selethai et Helihel
clem: et Elionai, et Selethai, et Eliel,
kjv: And Elienai, and Zilthai, and Eliel,

wlc: וַעֲדָיָה וּבְרָאיָה וְשִׁמְרָת בְּנֵי שִׁמְעִי ׃
lxx: καὶ Ἀβιὰ καὶ Βεριγὰ καὶ Βαραιὰ καὶ Σαμαράθ, υἱοὶ Σαμαείθ.
vulg: et Adaia et Baraia et Samarath filii Semei
clem: et Adaia, et Baraia, et Samarath, filii Semei.
kjv: And Adaiah, and Beraiah, and Shimrath, the sons of Shimhi;

wlc: וְיִשְׁפָּן וָעֵבֶר וֶאֱלִיאֵל ׃
lxx: καὶ Ἰσφὰν καὶ Ὤβδη καὶ Ἐλεὴλ
vulg: et Iesphan et Heber et Helihel
clem: Et Jespham, et Heber, et Eliel,
kjv: And Ishpan, and Heber, and Eliel,

wlc: וְעַבְדּוֹן וְזִכְרִי וְחָנָן ׃
lxx: καὶ Ἀβαδὼν καὶ Ζεχρεὶ καὶ Ἀνὰν
vulg: et Abdon et Zechri et Hanan
clem: et Abdon, et Zechri, et Hanan,
kjv: And Abdon, and Zichri, and Hanan,

wlc: וַחֲנַנְיָה וְעֵילָם וְעַנְתֹתִיָּה ׃
lxx: καὶ Ἀνανίὰ καὶ Ἀμβρεὶ καὶ Αἰλὰμ καὶ Ἀνωθαὶθ
vulg: et Anania et Ailam et Anathothia
clem: et Hanania, et lam, et Anathothia,
kjv: And Hananiah, and Elam, and Antothijah,

wlc: וְיִפְדְיָה וּפְנִיאֵל בְּנֵי שָׁשָׁק ׃
lxx: καὶ Ἀθεν καὶ Ἰεφερειὰ καὶ Φελιήλ, υἱοὶ Σωιήκ·
vulg: et Iephdaia et Phanuhel filii Sesac
clem: et Jephdaia, et Phanuel, filii Sesac.
kjv: And Iphedeiah, and Penuel, the sons of Shashak;

wlc: וְשַׁמְשְׁרַי וּשְׁחַרְיָה וַעֲתַלְיָה ׃
lxx: καὶ Ἰσμασαριὰ καὶ Σαραιὰ καὶ Ὀγοθολιὰ
vulg: et Samsari et Sooria et Otholia
clem: Et Samsari, et Sohoria, et Otholia,
kjv: And Shamsherai, and Shehariah, and Athaliah,

wlc: וְיַעֲרֶשְׁיָה וְאֵלִיָּה וְזִכְרִי בְּנֵי יְרֹחָם ׃
lxx: καὶ Ἰασαραιὰ καὶ Σαραιὰ καὶ Ἠλιὰ καὶ Ζαχρεὶ υἱοὶ Ἰραάμ.
vulg: et Iersia et Helia et Zechri filii Ieroam
clem: et Jersia, et Elia, et Zechri, filii Jeroham.
kjv: And Jaresiah, and Eliah, and Zichri, the sons of Jeroham.

wlc: אֵלֶּה רָאשֵׁי אָבוֹת לְתֹלְדוֹתָם רָאשִׁים אֵלֶּה יָשְׁבוּ בִּירוּשָׁלָםִ ׃ ס
lxx: οὗτοι ἄρχοντες πατριῶν, κατὰ γενέσεις αὐτῶν ἄρχοντες· οὗτοι κατῴκησαν ἐν Ἰερουσαλήμ.
vulg: hii patriarchae et cognationum principes qui habitaverunt in Hierusalem
clem: Hi patriarch, et cognationum principes, qui habitaverunt in Jerusalem.
kjv: These were heads of the fathers, by their generations, chief men. These dwelt in Jerusalem.

wlc: וּבְגִבְעוֹן יָשְׁבוּ אֲבִי גִבְעוֹן וְשֵׁם אִשְׁתּוֹ מַעֲכָה ׃
lxx: καὶ ἐν Γαβαὼν κατῴκησεν πατὴρ Γαβαών, καὶ ὄνομα γυναικὶ αὐτοῦ Μολχά·
vulg: in Gabaon autem habitaverunt Abigabaon et nomen uxoris eius Maacha
clem: In Gabaon autem habitaverunt Abigabaon, et nomen uxoris ejus Maacha:
kjv: And at Gibeon dwelt the father of Gibeon; whose wife's name was Maachah:

wlc: וּבְנוֹ הַבְּכוֹר עַבְדּוֹן וְצוּר וְקִישׁ וּבַעַל וְנָדָב ׃
lxx: καὶ υἱὸς αὐτῆς ὁ πρωτότοκος Ἀβαίων, καὶ Σοὺρ καὶ Κεὶς καὶ Βααλακαὶμ καὶ Ἀδὰδ
vulg: filiusque eius primogenitus Abdon et Sur et Cis et Baal et Nadab
clem: filiusque ejus primogenitus Abdon, et Sur, et Cis, et Baal, et Nadab,
kjv: And his firstborn son Abdon, and Zur, and Kish, and Baal, and Nadab,

wlc: וּגְדוֹר וְאַחְיוֹ וָזָכֶר ׃
lxx: καὶ Δοὐρ καὶ ἀδελφὸς αὐτοῦ καὶ Ζάχουρ καὶ Μακαλὼθ·
vulg: Gedor quoque et Ahio et Zacher
clem: Gedor quoque, et Ahio, et Zacher, et Macelloth:
kjv: And Gedor, and Ahio, and Zacher.

wlc: וּמִקְלוֹת הוֹלִיד אֶת־שִׁמְאָה וְאַף־הֵמָּה נֶגֶד אֲחֵיהֶם יָשְׁבוּ בִירוּשָׁלַםִ עִם־אֲחֵיהֶם ׃ ס
lxx: καὶ Μακαλὼθ ἐγέννησεν τὸν Σεμαά.καὶ γὰρ οὗτοι κατέναντι τῶν ἀδελφῶν αὐτῶν κατῴκησαν ἐν Ἰερουσαλὴμ μετὰ τῶν ἀδελφῶν αὐτῶν.
vulg: et Macelloth genuit Samaa habitaveruntque ex adverso fratrum suorum in Hierusalem cum fratribus suis
clem: et Macelloth genuit Samaa: habitaveruntque ex adverso fratrum suorum in Jerusalem cum fratribus suis.
kjv: And Mikloth begat Shimeah. And these also dwelt with their brethren in Jerusalem, over against them.

wlc: וְנֵר הוֹלִיד אֶת־קִישׁ וְקִישׁ הוֹלִיד אֶת־שָׁאוּל וְשָׁאוּל הוֹלִיד אֶת־יְהוֹנָתָן וְאֶת־מַלְכִּי־שׁוּעַ וְאֶת־אֲבִינָדָב וְאֶת־אֶשְׁבָּעַל ׃
lxx: καὶ Νὴρ ἐγέννησεν τὸν Κείς, καὶ Κεὶς ἐγέννησεν τὸν Σαούλ, καὶ Σαοὺλ ἐγέννησεν τὸν Ἰωναθὰν καὶ τὸν Μελχεσοῦε καὶ τὸν Ἀμειναδὰβ καὶ τὸν Ἀσάβαλ.
vulg: Ner autem genuit Cis et Cis genuit Saul porro Saul genuit Ionathan et Melchisuae et Abinadab et Esbaal
clem: Ner autem genuit Cis, et Cis genuit Saul. Porro Saul genuit Jonathan, et Melchisua, et Abinadab, et Esbaal.
kjv: And Ner begat Kish, and Kish begat Saul, and Saul begat Jonathan, and Malchishua, and Abinadab, and Eshbaal.

wlc: וּבֶן־יְהוֹנָתָן מְרִיב בָּעַל וּמְרִיב בַּעַל הוֹלִיד אֶת־מִיכָה ׃ ס
lxx: καὶ υἱοὶ Ἰωναθὰν Μεριβάαλ· καὶ Μεριβάαλ ἐγέννησεν τὸν Μιχιά.
vulg: filius autem Ionathan Meribbaal et Meribbaal genuit Micha
clem: Filius autem Jonathan, Meribbaal: et Meribbaal genuit Micha.
kjv: And the son of Jonathan was Meribbaal; and Meribbaal begat Micah.

wlc: וּבְנֵי מִיכָה פִּיתוֹן וָמֶלֶךְ וְתַאְרֵעַ וְאָחָז ׃
lxx: καὶ υἱοὶ Μιχιά· Φιθὼν καὶ Μελχὴλ καὶ ᵇερέε καὶ Ζάκ.
vulg: filii Micha Phithon et Melech et Thara et Ahaz
clem: Filii Micha, Phithon, et Melech, et Tharaa, et Ahaz.
kjv: And the sons of Micah were, Pithon, and Melech, and Tarea, and Ahaz.

wlc: וְאָחָז הוֹלִיד אֶת־יְהוֹעַדָּה וִיהוֹעַדָּה הוֹלִיד אֶת־עָלֶמֶת וְאֶת־עַזְמָוֶת וְאֶת־זִמְרִי וְזִמְרִי הוֹלִיד אֶת־מוֹצָא ׃
lxx: καὶ Σὰκ ἐγέννησεν τὸν Ἰὰδ καὶ Ἰάδα, καὶ Ἰαδὰ ἐγέννησεν τὸν Σαλαιμὰθ καὶ τὸν Σαλμὼ καὶ τὸν Ζαμβρεί, καὶ ἐγέννησεν Ζαμβρεὶ τὸν Μαισά·
vulg: et Ahaz genuit Ioada et Ioada genuit Almoth et Azmoth et Zamari porro Zamari genuit Mosa
clem: Et Ahaz genuit Joada, et Joada genuit Alamath, et Azmoth, et Zamri: porro Zamri genuit Mosa,
kjv: And Ahaz begat Jehoadah; and Jehoadah begat Alemeth, and Azmaveth, and Zimri; and Zimri begat Moza,

wlc: וּמוֹצָא הוֹלִיד אֶת־בִּנְעָא רָפָה בְנוֹ אֶלְעָשָׂה בְנוֹ אָצֵל בְּנוֹ ׃
lxx: καὶ Μαισὰ ἐγέννησεν τὸν Βανά· Ῥαφαὶ υἱὸς αὐτοῦ, Σαλασὰθ υἱὸς αὐτοῦ, Ἐσὴλ υἱὸς αὐτοῦ.
vulg: et Mosa genuit Baana cuius filius fuit Rapha de quo ortus est Elasa qui genuit Asel
clem: et Mosa genuit Banaa, cujus filius fuit Rapha, de quo ortus est Elasa, qui genuit Asel.
kjv: And Moza begat Binea: Rapha was his son, Eleasah his son, Azel his son:

wlc: וּלְאָצֵל שִׁשָּׁה בָנִים וְאֵלֶּה שְׁמוֹתָם עַזְרִיקָם בֹּכְרוּ וְיִשְׁמָעֵאל וּשְׁעַרְיָה וְעֹבַדְיָה וְחָנָן כָּל־אֵלֶּה בְּנֵי אָצַל ׃
lxx: καὶ τῷ Ἐσὴλ ἕξ υἱοί, καὶ ταῦτα τὰ ὀνόματα αὐτῶν· Ἐζρεικαὶ πρωτότοκος αὐτοῦ, καὶ Ἰσμαὴλ καὶ Σαραιὰ καὶ Ἀβδειὰ καὶ Ἀνόν· πάντες οὗτοι υἱοὶ Ἐσήλ.
vulg: porro Asel sex filii fuere his nominibus Ezricam Bochru Ismahel Saria Abadia Anan omnes hii filii Asel
clem: Porro Asel sex filii fuerunt his nominibus: Ezricam, Bocru, Ismahel, Saria, Obdia, et Hanan: omnes hi filii Asel.
kjv: And Azel had six sons, whose names are these, Azrikam, Bocheru, and Ishmael, and Sheariah, and Obadiah, and Hanan. All these were the sons of Azel.

wlc: וּבְנֵי עֵשֶׁק אָחִיו אוּלָם בְּכֹרוֹ יְעוּשׁ הַשֵּׁנִי וֶאֱלִיפֶלֶט הַשְּׁלִשִׁי ׃
lxx: καὶ υἱοὶ Ἀσηλ ἀδελφοῦ αὐτοῦ· Ἀἰλὰμ πρωτότοκος αὐτοῦ, καὶ Γὰγ ὁδεύτερος· Ἐλιφάλεις ὁ τρίτος.
vulg: filii autem Esec fratris eius Ulam primogenitus et Us secundus et Eliphalet tertius
clem: Filii autem Esec fratris ejus, Ulam primogenitus, et Jehus secundus, et Eliphalet tertius.
kjv: And the sons of Eshek his brother were, Ulam his firstborn, Jehush the second, and Eliphelet the third.

wlc: וַיִּהְיוּ בְנֵי־אוּלָם אֲנָשִׁים גִּבֹּרֵי־חַיִל דֹּרְכֵי קֶשֶׁת וּמַרְבִּים בָּנִים וּבְנֵי בָנִים מֵאָה וַחֲמִשִּׁים כָּל־אֵלֶּה מִבְּנֵי בִנְיָמִן ׃ פ
lxx: καὶ ἦσαν υἱοὶ Αἰλεὶμ ἰσχυροὶ ἄνδρες δυνάμει, τείνοντες τόξον καὶ πληθύνοντες υἱοὺς καὶ υἱοὺς τῶν υἱῶν, ἑκατὸν πεντήκοντα. πάντες οὗτοι ἐξ υἱῶν Βενιαμείν.
vulg: fueruntque filii Ulam viri robustissimi et magno robore tendentes arcum et multos habentes filios ac nepotes usque ad centum quinquaginta omnes hii filii Beniamin
clem: Fueruntque filii Ulam viri robustissimi, et magno robore tendentes arcum: et multos habentes filios ac nepotes, usque ad centum quinquaginta. Omnes hi filii Benjamin.
